en.title: Frequently asked questions
en.body:
Glossary:

  1. Something does not work, but it works for everyone else? (bust caches)

  2. What economy phase are we currently?

  3. How does a contest work?

  4. How to turn on chatrooms?

  5. What does Q mean?

  6. What are the NPC companies on the exchange?

  7. How do I level up?

  8. How to use the exchange?

  9. How do I send contracts?

  10. What do building upgrades do?

  11. How is the resource abundance for mines, rigs, and quarries assigned?

  12. Can I sell or destroy my buildings?

  13. Why does my administration cost go up?

  14. What’s accounting overhead?

  15. What’s research for?

  16. Where’s the game time table?

  17. How is Comprehensive Income calculated? 

  18. What are those symbols I see on company pics (avatars)?

  19. What does Purchases and Returns mean in the warehouse?

  20. I got a message from the Personal Assistant about worker wages increase/decrease and retail changes.

  21. Can I create more than one account?

  22. Why am I not getting any more Personal Assistant (PA) quests?

  23. How often are new features added?

  24. Why are incoming contracts different colors? (Red, Green, Black)

  25. How do I reset or delete my account?

  26. Attitude Control is not spelled wrong?

  27. Why haven’t I received my Sim Boosts from my purchase?

  28. Got your own question?

1. Something does not work, but it works for everyone else

Sim Companies stores data and code on your device to allow fast screen loads and game performance. However, some devices and browsers (safari), do not really follow industry standards and it may happen that your device does not automatically update when it should. Which can result in problems for your game-play.

Visit this link if you are experiencing issues: bust caches. (You need to visit this link from the device that is experiencing issues. If the link was posted in chat; it may not work.)

If nothing helps, you can report a bug here and write a message to the support.

In issue 99 of Sim Times there is an article about how to write to our support.

Here is a link to the Status page of Sim Companies. This allows players to see if the game is operating as it should.

Refreshing the game also fixes many issues without having to bust caches. To refresh on mobile; pull the screen down until you see the game refresh.

2. What economy phase are we currently?

Current economy phase: see your Headquarters (HQ)

There are three possible phases to the economy. Recession, Normal, and Boom.
Phases can only move one direction or remain the same.
Examples:
Boom, remain the same or go to a Normal economy
Recession, remain the same or go to a Normal economy
Normal, remain the same or go to Boom or Recession economy

Every Friday there is a chance that the economy can change.

15:00 UTC - Economy phase shift. See Time Table article in the Library for your local time when economic changes can occur.

Recession: production quantities are higher; while retailers selling quantity is lower.
Boom: production quantities are lower; while retailers selling quantity is higher.
Normal: is the balance between Boom and Recession.

Scroll down for more information: “I got a message from the Personal Assistant about worker wages increase/decrease and retail changes” (Number 20).

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:

The Numbers behind Economy Phases (1)

The Numbers behind Economy Phases (2)

Economy Impacts: Food Industry

Changes to the economy phases and their impact

3. How does a Contest work?

Contests take place over a two week period. But what is that? It is donating a product! 

The product remains the same for the entire period of the contest.

Whoever has gathered the most points at the end, receives a certificate which can be displayed in the profile. Points are awarded daily to the people who sent the most in the last 24 hours. The leader board screen will show the top 30 players; and your company rank at the bottom.

How can you donate? 

After opening the contest product in the Headquarters (warehouse), another button "Donate to contest" appears. 

What does the winner get? A certificate and a trophy on their Logo/Avatar. As well as a unique collectible of the product in that contest.

Please note that winning a contest costs tens of millions in cash and you should NOT donate anything if you’re not serious about it.

For example: 

Zipping through the Tulips ~ the winner donated 121,381,007 seeds, roughly $25.2 million.

4. How to turn on chatrooms?

Chatrooms: Game, Social, Sale, Aerospace Sales, Help, Roleplay, (DE) Sozial, (DE) Handel, (DE) Spiel, (FR) French), (FR) Vente, (PT) Jogo, (PT) Social, (PT) Comércio, (TR) Turkish, (IT) Italian, (ES) Spanish, (ZH) Mandarin, (PL) Polish, (CS) Czech, (HI) Hindi.
To see the chatrooms:

  1. Click/press on the three (3) dots above chatrooms.

  2. Account Settings (cog on the right)

  3. Chatrooms

  4. Check mark the ones you want to see

Chatrooms will save automatically when selected.

5. What does Q mean?  

Q means quality.  If you see someone using q0, q1, q2 they are referring to the quality of a product.   See Research Guide for more information about Quality.

More game abbreviations can be found in Sim Companies Times; Game Jargon (newspaper 75).

6. What are the NPC companies on the exchange?

NPC stands for Non-Player Character. It is a bot operated by Sim Companies, whose purpose is to provide game-essential resources to the exchange. The pricing is set up at the high side to allow players to sell at lower prices with profit. The resources the NPC provides: Seeds, Transportation, Power, Water, Reinforced Concrete, Bricks, Planks, and Construction Units.

7. How do I level up?

By constructing new buildings and using your buildings. Sending contracts and selling goods on the exchange will not contribute to your leveling. 

A more detailed explanation can be found here: Leveling and Experience Gain

8. How to use the exchange?

You need to visit your Headquarters (warehouse), click on the resource, click SELL ON THE EXCHANGE, enter a quantity and price, then press SELL ON THE EXCHANGE.

You will pay a market fee when the order is traded. The market fees are paid proportionally for every part of the order filled.

Depending on the resource, you may need to provide Transportation units as well. These can be bought on the exchange.

50x is the transport needed
$3 is the 3% fee (Note: the market fee can vary based on economic changes by the developers)
$0.030 is cost per unit
Note: transport is pulled from your inventory in your warehouse – if you do not have transport you cannot place anything on the exchange.

You can cancel your order on the market at any time by clicking/pressing on the blue X next to your name. Or going to your profile and finding the Market Orders box and selecting Cancel.

The transportation units will be returned to you since no product was shipped out of your warehouse.

The market fee that was not paid yet is refunded on cancel, but only after 48 hours from posting. Orders already placed cannot be modified, just cancelled.

(The example is for 3%; this value can change depending on economic changes by the developers)

For example, you place Crude Oil on the exchange for $28. You will pay a fee of $28 x 3% = $0.84 and use one transport unit, assume that transport costs $0.35. Hence, it will cost you $0.84 + $0.35 = $1.19 to sell the Crude Oil on the market, leaving you with $28 - $1.19 = $26.81. If you sold this Crude Oil using contracts, you pay no market fee and only use half of the transportation units. This would cost $0.35/2 = $0.175, meaning you would be left with $28 - $0.175 = $27.825. Remember to take this into account when deciding to sell on the exchange or to sell via contracts

(Note: the market fee can vary based on economic changes by the developers)

EXCHANGE PRIORITY

When viewing items on the exchange each listing has a priority based on the following:

price / quality / timestamp

Price: lower price has priority
Quality: higher quality has priority
Timestamp: longer time has priority

Timestamp is when it is entered or updated. When updating an order it resets the Timestamp and puts in the back of the line.

BUY ORDERS
Currently there is a level 25 requirement. 
Cost: 1 Sim Boosts per buy order.

Post a buy order
You can create a buy order that will stay on the exchange until:

  • There is a new sell order posted at the same price or lower
  • The order is cancelled - cash is refunded in full

Cash needs to be sent to the exchange when an order is posted and counts towards Accounting Overhead (see number 14) the same way as regular cash.

Your buy orders be found in Stats tab of your Warehouse.

All buy orders are hidden meaning you cannot see anyone else's buy orders.  

9. How do I send contracts?

Need to be level 5+ (Family Business) to send and receive contracts.

Video

Visit your Headquarters (warehouse) and click on the resource, enter quantity and price, and hit SEND CONTRACT. Enter the recipient company's name. The recipient has to accept your contract before the money can be credited to you. Either party can cancel the contract that has not been accepted yet and all resources, including Transportation units will be returned.

25x is the transport needed
There is no fee
Note: transport is pulled from your inventory in your warehouse – if you do not have transport you cannot send a contract.

In comparison to selling on the exchange, by using contracts you will not pay any market fee and need only half as many Transportation units.

10. What do building upgrades do?

All of your buildings can be upgraded to increase production/selling capacity. To upgrade a building you need to visit it and click the UPGRADE BUILDING button. All buildings start at level 1. Upgrading to level 2 doubles the production/selling capacity. A level 3 building will produce/sell 3 times as much as a level 1 building, a level 4 building will produce/sell 4 times as much as a level 1 building and so on.

One level 5 building = Five level 1 buildings (quantity)

11. How is the resource abundance for mines, rigs, and quarries assigned?

The production in the 3 mentioned buildings depends on resource abundance.

The abundance is randomly assigned when buildings is first built and then slowly decreases by 0.032% a day. Each resource produced in the building has its own abundance assigned using Gauss distribution with mean 0.6 (60% abundance) and standard deviation of 0.15. Resulting values over 1 (100%) are truncated to 1 (100%) and values below 0.1 (10%) are truncated to 0.1 (10%).

min(1.0, max(0.1, gauss(mu=0.6, sigma=0.15)))

Helpful information added via the Sim Companies Library:
Abundance

12. Can I sell or destroy my buildings?

You cannot sell your buildings but once you reach level 5 you can scrap buildings and recover some of the investment. If a building is level 1 or 2, you will get the full investment back. Any building above level 2 that is scrapped will not receive the full investment back. Destroying a level 5 building will return 5 times the value of a level 1 building.

Case one, construction resources for level 5 farm costs approximately $6,900 + $6,900 + $13,800 + $20,700 + $27,600 = $75,900 to build. If we scrap this level 5 building then we would receive only $6,900 x 5 = $34,500 worth of construction resources back.

Case two, construction resources for level 2 oil rig costs approximately $69,000 + $69,000 = $138,000 to build. If we scrap this level 2 building then we would receive construction resources back worth of $69,000 x 2 = $138,000.

Note: at Company level 20, Building Auctions are unlocked.

13. Why does my administration cost go up?

First of all, congratulations on building a huge company. Otherwise, you would not have this problem! The more employees that you have, the more money you spend on administration overhead. Every time you level up a building you increase the number of workers in your company by 100 as well as adding more administration staff. The more building levels that your company has, the more administration staff are recruited each time you level a building up.

If your administration size grows too much, you want to look at the following options: focus on less labor-intensive products, or invest in buildings that deliver high profit even on low levels. You could also invest in research, this will allow you to get a higher profit for the same resources without expanding your buildings. You may also want to look at hiring a COO, they reduce the administration overhead of your company. See the executives guide for more information.

14. What’s accounting overhead?

Managing all your company funds costs money. Here is how much your company pays in accounting overhead. Executives skilled in accounting can help you lower your accounting base. Buying bonds increases fees. Net Bonds plus Cash minus Executives. See the formula below.

Accounting base = (Bonds Purchased - Bonds Sold) + Cash - Executives' lift

Accounting base

Percentage

up to $3,000,000

0%

$3M to $6M

0.5%

$6M to $9M

1.0%

$9M to $12M

1.5%

$12M to $15M

2%

over $15,000,000

3%

Example with CFO lift:

$3 million + $4 million = $7 million

Cash and Bonds value over $7 million = $137,918
$137,918 x 0.5% = $690 (rounded up)

Accounting fees are deducted automatically every day at the same time. See Time Table for your local time.

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:

The Tax Man Cometh

Helpful information added via the Sim Companies Forum:

Bank - Need more Executive Lift?

15. What’s research for?

Research allows the production of higher quality products that sell faster allowing you to make more profit. The ability to research unlocks once your company has reached level 10.

You can build laboratories and research centers that produce research points. You can also buy them from other players on the exchange or through contracts. The research points can then be used to get patents, but not every research point result in a patent. So be prepared for losses from researching areas that bring no money.

Enough patents will allow you to produce higher quality products! Patents cannot be sold or transferred to other players.

See the research guide for more information.

16. Where’s the game time table?

The game runs on UTC time, but all times within the game are displayed in the company's local time zone.

See the time table to find out when the daily processes happen.

17. How is Comprehensive Income calculated? 

Comprehensive income is an item listed in the Income Statement in your HQ.  


It is a result of a two (2) consecutive Balance Sheets compared.  Any Company Value (CV) change that is not covered by the items in the Income Statement are called “other comprehensive income.”
Items on the Income Statement should cover all company activities that impact the Balance Sheet.  Except, for the Volume Weighted Average Price (VWAP) swings of inventory Valuation Allowance (85% of VWAP of the previous day).

Valuation Allowance is an item listed in the Balance Sheet.
Definition: Sum of price corrections applied to every single resource to account for resource liquidity. The correction estimates price you would get for each resource if you were to liquidate it on the market using the trading price and volume from the previous day.

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:

VWAP, VA, OCI Acronyms Oh My!

18. What are those symbols I see on company pics (avatars)?

There are three (3) symbols that can show up on company avatars:

Certificate Winner – A certificate for gaining a top spots in company rankings and years played.

Trophy Winner – A symbol awarded to those that have won the top spots in contests.

Supporter – A symbol notifying other players they support the game. You too can become a supporter!

All three will show up on the player’s profiles. The certificates can be displayed in the display case.

19. What does Purchases and Returns mean in the warehouse?

Purchases, means product purchased from the Exchange and/or Contracts.

Returns, means product cancelled from the Exchange and/or Contracts; and from Scrapping Buildings.

Purchases and Returns will be removed from that product once it is sold off.

20. I got a message from the Personal Assistant about worker wages increase/decrease and retail changes

The economy goes through phases. This message means the phase just changed. The overall margins on all products stay the same no matter the economy phase. However, the cost to produce products alternate so the retail prices alternate with it.

Checkout the encyclopedia to learn what are the new production costs and retail parameters.

This does not impact you as much if you are dealing with products that have an easy pipeline - or you operate on a just-in-time basis and hence do not store intermediate inventory. If, however, you hold a lot of inventory, the shift in pricing can cause your inventory to be worth more on the economic boom, or less on depression.

There are three phases that the economy can be in. When the economy goes up, retail speeds up, hence goods can be sold faster or can be sold at a higher price. However, the rate of production of these goods falls, therefore, producers will increase their prices to make up for this. When the economy goes down, retail slows down, hence goods sell slower or have to be sold at a lower price. In this case, the rate of production increases and hence producers can sell at a lower price.

21. Can I create more than one account?

This is prohibited.  That would create an unfair advantage over other players. See Fair Play Association (FPA).

Note: Realms created two (2) companies under one (1) account. One company in Magnates Realm and one company in Entrepreneurs Realm.

22. Why am I not getting any more Personal Assistant (PA) quests?

Make sure to scroll back to the last PA quest and answer the quest. Once you answer it the notification will go away and you will have access to the rest of the PA quests.

PA quests that are not answered will disappear and come back at a later date.

The newer quests that were added to the game have requirements that need to be met:

  1. Time Played

  2. How much cash that your company could potentially lose ($50,000).

  3. Executive requirements (level 15)

23. How often are new features added?

Major features are added to the game every month or two.

Small changes are deployed almost every second day, see the change log for the latest updates. There is always something to improve upon and I actively work on the game. If you want to see a few ideas that are under consideration, check out the future development page.

24. Why are incoming contracts different colors? (Red, Green, Black)

Contracts sent by companies will change colors if the price is different than the last accepted contract from that company. The price will change in color.

Red = Higher price than last accepted contract

Green = Lower price than last accepted contract

Black = Same price as last accepted contract

25. How do I reset or delete my account?


In Account Settings.

RESET ACCOUNT:

You will lose:

  1. Company Level

  2. Company money, warehouse inventory, buildings

  3. All Sim Boosts unlocks

  4. Company loans, bonds, research

  5. Production / sales bonus

You will keep:

  1. Supporter status

  2. Sim Boosts

  3. Certificates

  4. Collectibles

  5. Notes

To Delete your account go to DELETE ACCOUNT.

DELETE ACCOUNT:

Delete this Sim Companies account and all associated companies
Permanently delete all data associated to your account at Sim Companies.

As a safety feature you will have to verify the DELETE ACCOUNT through email.

26. Attitude Control is not spelled wrong?

“Attitude control is the process of controlling the orientation of an aerospace vehicle with respect to an inertial frame of reference.” (wikipedia)

27. Why haven’t I received my Sim Boosts from my purchase?

First of all, thx for for supporting the game!

  • If you used 

Braintree (direct card entry or Paypal) or ALGO, the system checks every hour for payments that did not reflect and auto refund them. The player who is refunded should get a PA message about payment being refunded, this should happen 99% of the time, but it can also happen that the system is not able to find the right player to match it to the refunded payment, in that case it is still refunded, but the PA message doesn't happen. So, please wait an hour, it should be refunded automatically.

  • If you used

Apple, please try clearing Cache and wait up to 24hrs, sometimes Apple needs some time to confirm the payment. Going back into the Sim Boost checkout and selecting the same Package and pressing "Buy"; may cause apple to process the purchase.  If your purchase has still not arrived, please send a screenshot of the purchase confirmation from Apple (Including order ID).

  • If you used 

Google pay (paying from the android app) or armor games: First of all, please clear the game cache on the affected device with this link. You can also try to open the buy screen in game again after about 15 minutes, this could trigger the purchase. Another thing that can help is to close and reopen the game.
Unfortunately, sometimes Google even needs up to one day to complete the purchase. If all failed and 24 hours have passed, we still need to issue refunds manually. If this is the case, please tell us your order details (Order ID and E-Mail, order ID starts with "GPA", you have received it from Google).

Concerning these problems, please contact our support.
www.simcompanies.com/report

28. Got your own question?

Try asking in the help chatroom, where other players will gladly answer your questions.

Game Guides

Guide for Beginners, Research Guide, Bonds Guide, Executive Guide, Government Orders Guide, Aerospace

zh-cn.title: 常见问题
zh-cn.body:
由The Center维护 / 由猫管及红薯翻译

内容：

  1. 某个游戏功能出了问题，但其他人都没有问题。怎么办？

  2. 目前是哪个经济阶段？

  3. 比赛是什么回事？

  4. 如何选择聊天室？

  5. 品质（Q）是什么？

  6. 交易所上的NPC公司是怎么回事？

  7. 如何升级？

  8. 如何在交易所上出售物资？

  9. 如何发送合同？

  10. 如何进行建筑升级？

  11. 矿井、采石场和油井的丰度是什么？

  12. 可以出售或拆建筑吗？

  13. 管理费用为什么增加？

  14. 会计费用是什么？

  15. 研究是为了什么？

  16. 游戏时间表在哪里？ 

  17. 游戏如何计算综合收益？

  18. 公司图片（徽标）上的那些符号是什么？

  19. 仓库中的采购和退货的意思是什么？

  20. 个人助理（PA）发的关于工人工资增减和销售变化的信息是怎么回事？

  21. 可以创建多家公司吗？

  22. 个人助理（PA）为什么不给我任务？

  23. 新功能多久增加一次？

  24. 为什么入库合同的颜色不一样（红、绿、黑）？

  25. 如何重置或删除账号？

  26. 公司股价是什么？

  27. 姿态控制器（Attitude Control）拼写错了吗？（中文没有影响）

  28. 为什么还没收到我购买的Simboosts？

  29. 有其他的问题？

1. 某个游戏功能不行，但对其他人都行。怎么回事？

Sim Companies把数据和代码存储在你的设备上，以实现快速的屏幕加载和游戏性能。但是，某些设备和浏览器（Safari）并不遵循行业标准，并且可能会发生设备不自动更新的情况。这可能会给你的游戏带来麻烦。

如果你遇到问题，访问此链接：清除缓存

如果这不解决你的问题，你可以在此处报告BUG并像支持人员写一条消息。

在Sim时报的第99期中，有一篇如何写好信息给我们的支持的文章。

如果你认为你遇到的是服务器或网络问题，你可以参见Sim Companies的网站状态页。

2. 目前是哪个经济阶段？

目前经济阶段：查看你的总部（HQ）

经济有三个阶段：萧条、平缓（正常情况）和景气。

经济阶段只能像一个“方向”转换或保持不变。
例如：

景气：不变或转换到经济平缓。

萧条：不变或转换到经济平缓。

平缓：不变或转换到经济萧条或景气。

每周五经济有可能会转换。

15:00 UTC - 经济阶段转换。有关可能发生经济转换的本地时间，访问文库中的时间表。

景气：生产速度比较低，而零售速度比较高。

萧条：生产速度比较高，而零售速度比较低。

平缓：萧条和景气之间的平衡。

以下有更多信息关于一条关于工资和零售变化的个人助理（PA）信息（20号）。

来自我们“当地”报纸《Sim Companies时报》的有用文章：

The Numbers behind Economy Phases (1)

The Numbers behind Economy Phases (2)

翻译：《经济阶段“背后”的数字》

3. 比赛是什么回事？

比赛历时两周。但是…如何参加？你得捐赠一种物资！

比赛期间，物资保持不变。

谁在比赛完成后收集了最多的分数，就会收到可以在档案中显示的证书。每天将积分奖励给过去24小时内捐赠最多的人。排行屏幕会显示前30名玩家，而你公司的排名则排在最下面。

如何捐赠？

在总部（仓库）中查看比赛物资的屏幕中显示一个“比赛捐赠“的按钮。

请注意，赢得比赛需要花费数千万的现金，如果你不认真对待比赛，则不应捐赠任何物资。

例如：

Zipping through the Tulips - 赢家捐赠了121 381 007种子，总价值大概是$2520万。

4. 如何选择聊天室？

聊天室：

英语：Game，Social，Sale，Aerospace Sales，Help，Roleplay

德语：[DE] Sozial，[DE] Handel，[DE] Spiel，[DE] Hilfe

葡萄牙语：[PT] Jogo，[PT] Social，[PT] Comercio

西班牙语：[ES] Juego，[ES] Ventas，[ES] Social，[ES] Roleplay

法语：[FR] Jeu，[FR] Vente，[FR] Social

意大利语：[IT] Gioco，[IT] Vendite

土耳其语：[TR] Oyun，[TR] Ticaret，[TR] Sosyal

中文：[ZH] Mandarin , [ZH] Social

如果要显示聊天室：

  1. 右上角的三（3）点

  2. 账号设置

  3. 聊天室

  4. 选你想看的聊天室

  5. 更新

5. 品质（Q）是什么？

Q代表品质。玩家说“Q0、Q1、Q2“等的时候，是代表某种物资的品质。有关品质的更多信息，访问研究指南。

有关游戏中更多缩写的信息，参见《Sim Companies时报》75期。

6. 交易所上的NPC公司是怎么回事？

NPC代表Non-Player Character（非玩家角色）。它是由Sim Companies操作的机器人，是为在交易所中提供必要的物资。定价比较高，来允许玩家以比较低的价格出售。

7. 如何升级（获得XP）？

通过建造新建筑并使用已存在的建筑。使用交易所或合同出售物资都不会对你的公司等级有所帮助。升级建筑也不会在这方面对你有任何帮助。

8. 如何在交易所上出售物资？【请注意，市场费已从3%提高到4%】

你得先访问你的总部（仓库），选一种物资，按交易所出售，输入数量和价格，最后按交易所出售。

注意：如果你有多个品质，你先得选一个。

订单完成后，你将支付3％的市场费。在获得任何利润之前，首先要扣除费用。根据物资的不同，你可能还需要付运输单位。你可以在交易所上购买。

500x是需要的运输单位。

$33是交易所的3％费用。（注：市场费用可能会根据开发者的经济调整而变化）

$0.033是每单位费用。

注意：这使用你仓库里的运输单位—如果仓库里没有运输单位，你无法出售任何需要运输单位的物资。

你可以通过按你名字旁边蓝色的“X”来随时取消你的交易所订单。

除此之外，你也可以到自己的个人主页找到市场订单，点击X取消订单。

由于没有物资真正从仓库运出，因此运输单位将全部退还给你。

还没付的市场费将在取消后退还，但仅在发布后48小时后退还。已下达的订单无法更改，只能取消。

比如说，你在交易所上以$28的价格出售原油。你会付$28 x 3% = $0.84的费用，并使用一个运输单位（假设每单位是$0.35）。因此，在交易所上出售原油将花费你$0.84 + $0.35 = $1.19，剩下的是：$28 - $1.18 = $26.82。如果你使用合同来出售原油，你将不但不付市场费用而且运输单位的一半。这样，花费你 $0.35/2 = $0.175，剩下的是$28 - $0.175 = $27.825。你选择用合同或用交易所时，注意这件事情。

（注：市场费用可能会根据开发者的经济调整而变化）

交易所订单优先级

交易所中的每个订单都具有基于以下内容的优先级：

  1. 价格

  2. 品质

  3. 时间

价格：较低的价格优先

品质：较高的品质优先

时间：较早的时间优先

时间戳记是输入或更新的时间。更新订单时（只能加数量），它会重置时间戳并放在行尾。

9. 如何发送合同？

你发送或收合同之前必须至少是5等级（家族企业）。访问你的总部（仓库），然后选物资，输入数量和价格，最后按发送合同。输入收件公司名称。收件家先得同意你的合同，你才能获得现金。任何一方都可以取消尚未接受的合同，并且将退还（包括运输单位）所有的物资。

25x是需要的运输单位。
无费用。
注意：这使用你仓库里的运输单位—如果仓库里没有运输单位，你无法出售任何需要运输单位的物资。

与在交易所上出售相比，通过使用合同你将不支付任何市场费，只需要一半的运输单位。

10. 如何进行建筑升级？

所有建筑可以升级来增加生产/零售速度。要升级建筑，你需要访问它，然后按升级。所有建筑以1级开始。升级到2级把生产或零售速度长一倍。一座3级建筑的生产/零售量是1级建筑的3倍，4级建筑是生产/零售量是1级建筑的4倍，等等。

1座5级建筑的生产/零售量＝5座1级建筑的生产/零售量。

11. 矿井、采石场和油井的丰度是什么？

这三种建筑的生产量取决于物资丰度。

刚开始建设建筑时会随机分配丰度，然后每天降低0.032%（每个月~1%）。每种在建筑里生产的物资有其自己的丰度，使用高斯分布分配，平均值为0.6（60%丰度），标准差为0.15。超过1（100%）的结果值将被阶段为1（100%），而低于0.1（10%）的值被阶段为0.1（10%）。

min(1.0, max(0.1, gauss(mu=0.6, sigma=0.15)))

Sim Companies论坛的有关文章：
Abundance - A quick review

翻译：《丰度－快速回顾》

12. 可以出售或拆建筑吗？

可以，5级及以上的公司可以拆除建筑物并收回部分材料投资。如果建筑物为是1或2级，你会获得全部材料。2级以上的任何建筑物都不会收回全部材料。拆掉一座5级建筑将返回1级建筑材料（价值）的5倍。

例子1：5级种植园的建设材料成本大约为$6 900 + $6 900 + $13 800 + $20 700 + $27 600 = $75 900。如果你拆这座5级建筑，那么你将只能收到$6 900 x 5 = $34 500的建筑材料。

例子2：2级油井的建设材料成本大约为$69 000 + $69 000 = $138 000。如果你拆这座2级建筑，那么你将收到$69 000 x 2 = $138 000。

13. 管理费用为什么增加？

祝贺你建立了一家庞大的公司！否则，你不会遇到此问题！你拥有的工人越多，你得花的管理费用就越多。每次升级建筑时，公司中的工人数量都会增加100，同时还会增加更多的管理人员。你的公司拥有的建筑级越高，每次升级建筑时，就会招聘更多的管理人员。每个建筑等级都会增加0.588%的管理费用。

如果你的管理费用增加太多，你可以查看以下选项：专注于劳动强度比较低的物资，或者投资于即使在比较低的等级也能带来高利润的建筑。你也可以投资研究，这将使你在不升级建筑的情况下使用相同的物资获得更高的利润。你也可能还需要考虑聘请一个COO，这样可以减少公司的管理费用。有关更多信息，请参见《高管指南》。

14. 会计费用是什么？

“管理”公司的所有资金也花钱！这是公司支付的会计费用。精通会计的高管可以帮助你提高会计起付额度，（从此开始支付会计费用）。

会计起付额度＝（拥有债券－售出债券）＋现金－受益于高管

会计起付额度

百分比

高达$3 000 000

0%

$3 000 000至$6 000 000

0.5%

$6 000 000至$9 000 000

1.0%

$9 000 000至$12 000 000

1.5%

$12 000 000至$15 000 000

2%

超过$15 000 000

3%

受到CFO利益的例子：

$3 000 000 + $10 500 000 = $13 500 000

超过$13 500 000的现金和债券 = $109 995
$109 995 x 0.5% = $550

会计费用每天在同一时间自动扣除。请参阅时间表来看当地时间。

有关的《Sim Companies时报》文章：

The Tax Man Cometh

翻译：《收税员来了！》

Sim Companies论坛中的有用信息：

银行－需要更多有关会计费用的帮助？

15. 研究是为了什么？

研究可以提高物资品质，给你生产出品质更高的物资的能力。品质越高，就零售的更快，从而使你获得更多利润。公司达到10级后就可以开始研究！

你可以建设产生研究分的实验室和研究中心。你还可以在交易所或通过合同从其他玩家购买研究分。然后可以使用这些研究分获得专利，但并非每个研究分都可以获得专利。因此，要做好损失准备。

足够的专利将使你生产更高品质的物资！专利不能出售或转让给其他玩家。

有关更多信息，请参见《研究指南》

16. 游戏时间表是在哪里？

游戏以UTC时间运行，但是游戏中的所有时间都显示在你公司的本地时区中。

请看时间表来了解日常发生的过程。

17. 游戏如何计算综合收益？

其他综合收益是总部（HQ）利润表中列出的一项。

它是两（2）份连续的资产负债表比较的结果。任何公司价值（CV）的变化，如果不包括在利润表的项目中，则成为“其他综合收益“。利润表的项目应该涵盖影响资产负债表的所有公司活动。不过，库存估价备抵的音量加权平均价格（VWAP）动摇（前一天VWAP的85%）。

估价备抵是资产负债表中所列的一个项目。

定义：对库存物资总价的修正，其数值基于物资的清算价格。清算价格与市场均价的差值可以理解为“物资流动性不足造成的折价”。即，尽管可以假设物资能以前一个交易日的平均价格出售，但是，由于破产清算的急迫性，往往需要折价出售。估价备抵就体现了这个价差。

18. 公司图片（徽标）上的那些符号是什么？

有三种可以在公司徽标上的符号：

证书持有人－此公司得了证书，代表快速增长，排名很高或玩了很长时间。

奖杯得主－授予比赛赢家。

支持者－这符号表明该玩家支持Sim Companies。你也可以成为一个支持者！

所有都会在档案上出现。证书可以显示在展柜中。

19. 仓库中的采购和退货的意思是什么？

购买，是指从交易所和/或合同中购买的产品。

退货，是指从交易所和/或合同中取消的产品；以及拆除建筑物。

一旦该产品售出，将从中删除购买和退货（记录）。

以这种格式直接从你的备注中复制和粘贴，会在聊天室中显示出正确的图像！

20. 个人助理（PA）发的关于工人工资增减和销售变化的信息是怎么回事？

经济会经历一些阶段。这条信息意味着阶段刚刚发生变化。无论经济阶段如何，所有物资的整体利润率都保持大致相同的。但是，物资的生产成本会发生变化，所以零售价格也会随之变化。

查看百科，了解新的生产成本和零售参数有哪些。

如果你处理的是容易加工的物资—或者你是按“及时制”运作，因此不储存中间库存，这对你的影响不太大。然而，如果你持有大量的库存，价格的变化可能会导致你的库存在经济繁荣时价值更高，或在经济萧条时价值更低。

经济可以分为三个阶段。当经济上升时，零售速度加快，因此，物资可以更快的出售，或可以以比较高的价格出售，但这些物资的生产速度下降，因此，生产者会提高价格来弥补。当经济下滑时，零售业放缓，因此物资零售速度减慢，或不得不以比较低的价格出售。在这种情况下，生产速度增加，生产者可以以比较低的价格出售。

21. 可以创建多家公司吗？

这是禁止的。这将给其他玩家带来不公平的优势。请参阅公平竞争协会（FPA）。

22. 个人助理（PA）为什么不给我任务？

确保回到最后一个个人助理（PA）任务，并回答。一旦你回答了它，通知就会消失，你就可以进入其余的PA任务。

PA任务如果长时不回答，就会消失，以后再来。

游戏中新增加的任务，都有些要求：

  1. 玩的时间

  2. 你的公司有可能损失多少现金（$50 000）

  3. 高管要求（15等级）

23. 新功能多久增加一次？

主要功能每月或每两个月加到游戏中。

几乎每隔一天会部署小更改，有关最新更新，请参阅更改日志。总有需要改进的方面，Patrik积极改进游戏。如果你想查看一些正在考虑的想法，请查看《未来发展》。

24. 为什么入库合同的颜色不一样（红、绿、黑）？

如果其他公司发送的合同有价格变化，会有颜色变化。

红 = 价格比上个合同高

绿 = 价格比上个合同低

黑 = 价格跟上个合同一样

25. 如何重置或删除账号？

去账号设置、重置。那里有2个选择：

  1. 重置账号：“你正要将账户还原到初始状态。你将失去目前的所有库存、建筑、现金、解锁物品和Simboosts。你的身份认证信息、公司名称和支持者状态将会保留。此操作无法撤销。”

  2. 删除账号：“这将会删除你的账号和删除全部你在Sim Companies的资料。你将会无法登录或玩Sim Companies。”

26. 公司股价是什么？

股价是衡量公司增长的指标。目前仅用于展示。玩家会开始看到股价和股数在$90万至$100万的公司价值（CV）之间。目前无法买卖股份。

要了解有关股价的更多信息，请阅读以下《Sim时报》文章：

81期 - Company Shares Intro－翻译：《公司股份介绍》
83期 - Share Price Puzzle – Solution Revealed!－翻译：《股价难题－解决方案揭晓！》

27. 姿态控制器（Attitude Control）拼写错了吗？（中文没有影响）

“Attitude control is the process of controlling the orientation of an aerospace vehicle with respect to an inertial frame of reference.” (Wikipedia)

28. 为什么还没收到我购买的Simboosts？

首先，感谢你对游戏的支持！

如果你使用了：

  • Braintree（直接输卡或PayPal）：游戏系统每小时检查一次有没有未反映的付款，并自动退款。收退款的玩家应该收到一条关于付款被退还的PA信息，这应该在99%的情况下发生，但有时，系统无法找正确的玩家与被退款的付款相匹配。在这种情况下，付款仍然会被退还，但PA不会通知。所以，请耐心等一个小时，它应该自动被退款。

  • Apple：请清楚你的设备缓存并等24小时左右。如果你的Simboosts还没到达，请发送Apple的购买确认书的截图。

  • Google Pay（从Android APP付款）或Armor Games：首先，请清楚你的设备缓存。你也可以尝试在大约15分钟后重新打开游戏中的购买界面，这可能会触发你的购买。另一件可以帮助的事情是关闭并重新打开游戏。不幸的是，有时Google可能需要长达一天的时间来完成购买。如果所有其他方法都失败了，而且已经过了24小时，我们仍然需要手动发放退款。如果是这种情况，请告诉我们你的订单细节（订单编号和电邮地址，订单编号以"GPA"开头，你使用了Google）。

与付款有关的问题请联系我们的支持：

BUG报告

29. 有其他问题？

请在【中文】游戏聊天室中问一问，资深玩家们会回答你的问题。

文库文章/指南：

常见问题，新人指南，研究指南，建筑业指南，债券指南，高管指南，政府订单指南，航空航天业指南

en.title: Supported platforms
en.body:
What are all the ways you can play Sim Companies?

The selection of technologies used for Sim Companies was heavily influenced by the desire for the game to be playable across many devices - and ideally, all of them executing the same underlying code, so the game both looks the same on any device and also to lower maintenance overhead. We do not want to be implementing every feature 3 times, we also do not want for some devices to have features others do not have.

The technologies used are those that most browsers can work with - this allows great compatibility, as most devices have a web browser.

Sim Companies is also using cutting edge caching techniques to allow instant page loads and partial offline functionality, called PWA (Progressive Web App)

PC OR LAPTOP

You can play the game on your browser. Sim Companies has a test suite that uses Chrome as a benchmark, but we strive to remain fully compatible with all major browsers: Firefox, Edge, and Safari. There are no known functionality limitations on the mentioned browsers.

ANDROID DEVICE

There are few choices on how to play on Android, you can either play using the browser. You can also install the android app from the Android Play Store. To adhere to the before-mentioned principles, the android app simply loads a browser inside the app and runs the Sim Companies website (this is often referred to as a WebView wrapper app). So there are no functional differences or advantages when using the app. You may ask, what’s even the purpose of having the app then? Users are used to looking for games in the Play Store. The sole purpose of the app is to have a presence in the store so you can find the game easily.

My favorite option to play on an android device is using the PWA (Progressive Web App). Sim Companies is PWA compatible, so when using it on the browser, you will be asked if you want to add it to the homepage. (Or you can do that manually from the browser menu). Once you do that and kick off the app from your phone’s home page you will get the exact app-like experience: no browser location bar, full functionality, without installing any app.

iOS DEVICE

This is actually the same as the Android device compatibility, you can do either of: PWA (Progressive Web App - explained above), using safari browser, or a dedicated iOS application from the Apple App Store.

To put a PWA shortcut on your Home screen, do the following:

  1.  Tap the Share button in Safari for the PWA you’re using.

  2.  Tap the icon labeled Add to Home Screen.

  3.  Tap Add in the upper-right corner.

  4.  Now name your PWA, then tap Add in the upper-right corner.

PWA will give you a full app-like experience, no location bar, all features.

The main purpose of the iOS application is the presence in the App Store - where players search for games.

MICROSOFT STORE

Can download the game from the Microsoft Store and play in a standalone application or play from Microsoft Edge browser.

AUTHENTICATION

I encourage everyone to put an email in their account settings. In case you lose access to your company, you can only recover it if the email is set up.

You can log in using an email and password.

If you lose access and you did not set any password, you can go through the password reset flow, assuming your email was set.

You can use Facebook SSO (single sign-on) to auth to your company

Most emails sent from Sim Companies have links in them that sign you in.

Android Play Store app remembers your company and authenticates you automatically.

SIM BOOST PURCHASES

Is there any difference in Sim Boosts purchase options? Yes, there has to be. While for websites there are no strict rules on how purchases can be facilitated, the Play Store and App Store have some strict rules - mainly forcing the payment to go through their store, this means Sim Companies loses control over few aspects of the billing including currency conversion rates. So the price offer may differ when doing purchases from the native app, or from the web/browser/PWA.

zh-cn.title: 支持平台
zh-cn.body:
由 Patrik 编写 / 由 Silverman AG 翻译

你可以用什么方式或设备来玩Sim Companies？

Sim Companies的技术选择在很大程度上受到了游戏可在很多种设备上玩的愿望的影响-- 最好是所有设备都使用相同的底层代码，这样游戏在任何设备上看起来都一样。这也使得维护和更新更加容易。我们不希望每项功能都要实现3次，我们也不希望某些设备有其他设备没有的功能。

所使用的技术是那些大多数浏览器可以工作的技术-- 这允许很大的兼容性，因为大多数设备可以使用网络浏览器。

Sim Companies利用现代先进的缓存技术，允许即时页面加载和部分离线功能，称为渐进式网络应用程序（PWA）。

电脑或笔记本电脑

你可以在你的浏览器上玩这个游戏。Sim Companies使用Chrome浏览器作为基准，但我们努力保持与所有主要浏览器完全兼容：火狐、Microsoft Edge和Safari。在上述浏览器上没有已知的功能限制。

安卓（Android）设备

关于如何在安卓上玩，有几个选择，你可以使用浏览器玩，但也可以从谷歌游戏商店安装安卓APP。为了坚持前面提到的原则，安卓APP只是在应用内加载一个浏览器，并运行Sim Companies的网站（这通常被称为WebView封装器应用）。这样一来，在使用该APP时，就没有任何功能上的差异和优势。你有可能会问，那么拥有这个APP的目的是什么？用户已经习惯于在移动APP商店寻找游戏。该APP的唯一目的是在谷歌游戏商店中占有一席之地，以便你能容易找到Sim Companies。

在我看来，在安卓设备上玩的最好方法是使用PWA（渐进式网络应用程序）。Sim Companies是兼容PWA的，所以在浏览器上使用时，会问你是否要把它加到手机主屏幕上。（你也可以从浏览器菜单中手动完成）。一旦你这样做，并从你的手机主屏幕打开该应用程序，你将获得完全于APP同样的体验：没有浏览器的位置栏，功能齐全，无需安装任何APP。

iOS设备

你的选择与安卓设备的选择相同，你可以使用：PWA（渐进式网络应用程序-- 以上有解释），Safari浏览器，或者从苹果APP商店下载一个专门的iOS APP。

要把PWA的快捷方式放在你的主屏幕上，请执行以下操作：

  1.  在Safari浏览器中点击你所使用的PWA的分享按钮。

  2.  点选标有添加到主屏幕的图标。

  3.  点击右上角的添加。

  4.  现在为你的PWA命名，然后点击右上角的添加。

该APP的主要目的是在苹果游戏商店中占有一席之地，以便你能容易找到Sim Companies。

请注意：iOS还没有推送通知功能。

MICROSOFT STORE

可从 Microsoft Store 下载游戏并在独立应用程序中进行游戏，或通过 Microsoft Edge 浏览器进行游戏。

认证

鼓励每个人在账号设置中放入一个电邮地址。万一你失去了对账号的访问权，只有设置了电邮地址，你才能恢复。

你可以使用电邮地址和密码登录。

如果你失去了访问权，而且你没有设置任何密码，你可以通过密码重置程序，如果你的账号已经有了一个电邮地址。

你可以使用Facebook SSO（单点登录）来登录你的账户。

大多数从Sim Companies发出的邮件中都有自动登录的链接。

iOS和Android的APP会“记住”你的公司，并自动对你进行认证。

SIMBOOST购买

根据设备的不同，simboosts的购买选项是否有区别？是的，必须有。虽然对如何通过网站进行购买没有严格的规定，但谷歌游戏商店和苹果APP商店有一些严格的规定-- 主要是迫使付款要通过他们的商店进行。这意味着Sim Companies失去了对计费的几个方面的控制，包括货币转换率。因此，从APP商店的APP跟从浏览器/PWA进行购买时，价格会有所不同。

en.title: Guide for beginners
en.body:
Welcome to Sim Companies. This guide will help you grasp some key mechanics of the game and its economy simulation. It is recommended that you complete the Game Tutorial first; it will show you how to start production and how to buy and sell items. This guide takes a closer look.

It’s important to remember that there is no wrong way to play this game. There isn’t a “best” industry, strategy, or map layout. The game economy isn’t fixed, so what worked great for someone 6 months ago may not work now. Learn how things work, have fun, set your own goals and see how minor changes can have a large effect. 


FIRST STEPS

The first goal of your business will be to generate revenue. There are primarily two modes of generating revenue. 

You can produce goods using production buildings (e.g. Farm, Ranch) and then trade them for a profit with other companies through the Exchange or contracts (level 5 and above). Alternatively, you can retail end products through retail buildings (e.g. Grocery) that convert them to cash. 

Both production and retail have unique mechanics of their own and you can decide whether focusing on production, retail, or a mix of both best suits your game plan. If you need time to make sense of the game, it is encouraged to have both a Grocery and Farm/Ranch to get a feel of both production and retail. It also ensures you’ll be able to safely generate revenue by your own means at the start.

In the beginning, companies at lower levels cannot put in long overnight orders. Build time will increase as you gain levels. As with all good common business sense, as long as you are making a profit, you’re on the right track.

Retail Buildings

Check out what you can sell in the grocery store by clicking on the building and which of the products have the highest demand. 

  • You can set a sale order by listing the quantity and price of the product. The average profit per item and the total time will be shown based on your inputs.

  • The average price states what others are selling at. 

  • Sales speed determines how much time is required to retail a batch of products. The time taken is translated into operational cost in the form of wages. 

  • Sales speed is influenced by two factors. Higher demand and higher quality increases the sales rate.

  • Sales price sets the desired profit margin of each product. Note that higher sell prices decreases the sales rate and vice versa, and you can calculate the optimal price to maximize profit/hour. 

  • Pro-tip -  the average profit per item is a good factor to consider, however the key principle you really want to find balance in is the average profit turnover rate. At times, setting a lower price may gain you a larger profit at the end of the day. Selling 60 items at $2.5 profit/unit at a rate of 1 minute/unit - totaling $150 profit in 1 hour, or 40 items at $3 profit/unit at rate of 1.5 minute/unit; totaling $120 in 1 hour

You don't need to pay too much attention to the average price - that's just information about what others are selling at. The demand is important because it determines how fast you sell and, essentially, what will be your per-unit profit. Let's assume that apples are high in demand right now.

Gaining Experience

You gain experience points while buildings are working; to level up fast, keep your buildings busy. 

BUILDINGS

Buildings are the core of your company. They can be built with new construction and/or upgraded to add more value to your company.

On top of the variety of production and retail buildings, there are two (2) fixed buildings that you cannot upgrade, destroy or move: Headquarters (HQ) and Exchange. 

Construction/Building Upgrades

Constructing new buildings is how your company grows and adds value. Each building allows you to produce different items or to sell items that are produced.

Building upgrades allow you to produce or sell more from each building slot.

If you make a mistake or change your plans you can scrap buildings. This returns your construction materials back to you so you can build or upgrade more of your buildings.

Note: Buildings that are level 1 and level 2 will return all construction materials. Any building level 3+ you begin to lose your construction materials. (For more about this see Construction Industry Guide.)

Headquarters (HQ)

The Headquarters building is the one with your company name on the Map. It contains all of your financial information. In it, you can keep track of your Company Value (CV), cash flow and transactions. You will also receive a daily update on your Income Statement. As you level up, Bonds (level 10) and Executives (level 15) will be unlocked. 

To access the Accounting tab; there are two ways. Select the headquarters on your map or by selecting the cash at the top. Then select Accounting to see your company’s financial information.

The Warehouse is also located inside of your Headquarters.

The Warehouse is where you can find your inventory and view details about it. Clicking on one of the items in storage will show the cost details for that item, breaking down the labor, admin, and component costs. You can also choose to put a batch of goods on the Exchange, send contracts, display items on your profile, or block them to prevent unintended usage. You can also see the first 5 market orders and any recent transactions you have made. 

An important thing to note is transportation. Transportation units are necessary to place goods on the Exchange or send contracts. In this case, 1 orange requires 1 transport unit. The number of transport units required per item can be found in your Warehouse or in the Encyclopedia. Contracts require half of the transport requirement shown. 

Whether you choose to trade on Exchange or through contracts, be mindful to factor in the hidden cost of transport as they do not appear on your cash flow.

Note: You do not need Transport units to sell in Retail buildings.

Tip: A quick way to access both your Headquarters and Warehouse; select the Green cash up in the upper right corner by your company logo.

Exchange


The Exchange is the common place where buyers and sellers trade for goods. 

Make sure when selling products on the exchange it is listed as priced per unit and not the total price.

Items on the Exchange are listed with the lowest price at the top. Items of higher quality will also take precedence over lower quality items of the same price. Likewise, when products on the market are bought, those at the top of the exchange are sold first. Changing the minimum quality (gold stars) will filter the list of products to the specified quality or higher. 

Note that a market fee is applied to the total sale value of goods sold through the Exchange. For example, an order of 1 apple priced at $2.00 will have a fee of $0.06 and an approximate transport cost of $0.35, leaving you with about $1.59 to cover your cost. Market fees affect the actual profit value of each product, so factor them into your cost when deciding on the sales price, especially for lower-priced items (e.g. sand).

You can choose to cancel the Exchange order by locating your listed product and clicking the “x” beside it. You will be charged market fees if you cancel an order before 48 hours upon the time of listing. There will be no market fees charged after 48 hours. Unsold items on the exchange will be automatically returned to your warehouse after 2 weeks.

Visit Frequently Asked Questions for a walkthrough on how to sell items on the Exchange.

CONTRACTS

What are contracts? A contract is a trade of goods between two (2) players. In order to do contracts (send or receive) you must be at least level 5. Contracts are also the suggested method of doing trades between companies because there is no market fee like the exchange and transportation is half of what is listed for that product in the Encyclopedia (see below).

Players have a number of options in game to find contracts with other players.

Short Video on finding Suppliers

  1. Sales Chat, is a chatroom for sales only and is one of the first places to find buyers/sellers.

  2. Company Tagging is a way to search for players selling or buying all the products in game (see Interface Tips “Company Tagging”).

  3. Exchange, you can see who is selling specific products.

Once you have found a potential trade partner reach out to them via Private Message; you negotiate with them the Price and Quantity for your contract(s).

Once an agreement has been set contracts can be one time trade or they can be daily.

Visit Frequently Asked Questions for a walkthrough on how to sell items through contracts.

Note: Sim Companies is Buyer Beware. Meaning players have the freedom to be scammed. Always verify contract prices when negotiating prices and verify the price(s) sent to the warehouse. Everyone is allowed to refuse or cancel a contract. If a company sent the wrong price; contact them via Private Message to confirm the price negotiated. Everyone has the right to use the Ignore feature on player’s profiles; if the prices did not meet your company standards. Using the ignore feature blocks incoming Contracts and Private Messages.

THE ENCYCLOPEDIA

The Encyclopedia is your friend. It holds a wealth of information about the products in the game. Learn how to use it and referring to it often will help you make smart decisions. 

The screenshot below is what a beginning player will see for apples. As you grow and get a good CFO, you’ll see information in the Profit Calculator too.

How to Read the Encyclopedia Listing:

At the top, you’ll see the requirements to build/grow items. In this case, 3 water and 1 seed is required for every apple. 100 apples would require 300 water and 100 seeds. 

Next is the “building” that produces apples - the Farm, as well as what consumes apples - the Grocery Store. 

Next up is the Production Calculator. This helps you figure out how much you can produce, and how much upgrades will boost production. Play with the settings to see how your production and costs change. Mine, Quarry, and Oil Rig products will have a 4th variable - Abundance. The higher the Abundance the easier it is to mine. Mines, Quarries, and Rigs also lose abundance 0.032% per day. Young companies are fine with a 85% Abundance or higher because of lower Admin costs, but later on most people look for 95% or higher. The longer you plan on keeping the Abundance building, the higher the Abundance you want to start with. 

The Sales Calculator is similar to the Production, but applies to the Sales Building. Play with these settings to see how an upgrade will boost selling speed. This is only available for products that can be sold in a Store. 

The Chart shows retail price and volume history. In this case the demand for apples has been very steady, but the retail price has bounced between around $4 to $4.30.


MISCELLANEOUS

Game Updates and News

Change Log

Players can access the Change Log via the Library at any time. The Change log covers updates to the game listed by Date.

News

Major updates to the game are announced in the Sim Companies Times by Patrik, the game developer. Everyone receives a Personal Assistant message about Sim Times articles every week. Pay attention for anything written by Patrik to stay informed about game updates.

Personal Assistant (PA)

Wondering about the Personal Assistant? Your PA will notify you on the following

  1. Contracts refused by other companies 

  2. Changes in the economy

  3. Sim Companies Times articles

Early in the game your PA will present a series of business related problems. How you respond to them is completely up to you, but there are benefits or consequences to your choice. They are designed to help you earn extra money and make good business decisions. If you are struggling, you can see Personal Assistant Quests from reddit.

Make sure you answer every quest. Sometimes players don’t get quests and the reason is they have not answered the last quest they received from the PA.

Note: The newer quests that were added to the game have requirements that need to be met:

  1. Time Played

  2. How much cash that your company could potentially lose ($50,000).

  3. Executive requirements (level 15)

Sim Boosts

What are Sim Boosts? Sim Boosts are blue stars that can be earned daily. Or can be purchased with real currency. They are used to unlock/speed up/switch items in the game. Cash earned in game cannot buy Sim Boosts. 

Here is a list of all the uses for Sim Boosts.

You can use Sim Boosts to: (suggested order)

  1. Unlock four (4) building slots (50, 100, 500, 500)

  2. Move production speed bonus to sales speed bonus and vice-versa (Headquarters - HQ)

  3. Unlock Executive slots (50, 100, 200, 400, 500)

  4. Upkeep recreational buildings: park, lake, castle (40 a week)

Other Sim Boost uses: (no particular order)

  • Advertise your company in the Sim Companies Times

  • Rush building construction and upgrades, this means you do not have to wait for construction and upgrade to finish

  • Rush executives training and hiring

  • Exchange Sim Boosts for in-game money - limited to $10,000 a day 

  • Unlock display case slots, where you can showcase your certificates, inventory, and achievements

Unlock Four (4) building slots (Sim Boost cost: 50, 100, 500, 500)

Beginner Boost

When you first start, your building’s production is accelerated to help you get off to a good start. Take advantage of this and keep your buildings as busy as you can. It’s a great way to produce low cost materials. 

Note: time shown in image is based on when this screenshot was taken. Your time will be different.


Creating More than One Account to Get Ahead?

Thinking outside the box, right? New companies get substantial start-up boosts, to make the game fun to play at the beginning and, sadly, some players try to abuse this to gain an unfair advantage against honest players.

This is why having more than one account is strictly prohibited.

Also, small companies are more restricted regarding what prices they can sell resources at, or send contracts.

There are monitoring mechanisms in place. It's very easy to check if the contracts or market orders a company is receiving are substantially lower-priced than the average price in the game for the concerned goods. Same, if a company sells to other players at much higher prices than the average.

If you try this approach you will get caught.


This guide should cover you to Level 10

Take this time to learn, read the guides, and then go back and read them again. This game is complex, so don’t expect to learn everything at once. Much like a real business, it takes time to grow. The PA Quests will help you in the beginning and give you rewards. Frequent reviews of the Encyclopedia will help you understand the interdependencies of products.

If you have kept your buildings at level 2 or below, you can scrap for full value and try something else if you like. But eventually you will want to pick an industry and specialize. Power is one of the easiest, Aerospace is the most complex. There are many other choices in between. Just pick what sounds interesting, fits your style, and stay with it a while. 

Whatever you decide to go with, keep at it and optimize the flows. You need enough cash to experiment and explore other industries. If you are a manufacturer, try to find somebody who will take your goods using contracts so you can save on market fees. It's also good to have stability. 

Similarly, if you are a retailer, find stable suppliers with prices better than the Exchange.

GUIDES

There are many useful guides in the Library. Scrolling past the newspapers will reveal many guides. It is highly recommended that you read these guides; they will help you understand the mechanics of the game.

After reading this guide check out some of the other guides listed in the library:

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) - Is a list of questions and answers, that are very common for new players to ask.

Interface Tips - How to use many of the features of the game. Navigation Bar, Chat, Production Values, Warehouse, Exchange, Headquarters (HQ), Buildings, Notes, and Charts.

Abundance - Reviews what Abundance means on Resource buildings.

Leveling Up and Experience Gain - How to level up and understand what gives experience.

Research Guide - Covers what research and quality are with means to obtain both.

Construction Guide - Covers construction, what is needed for constructing new buildings, and how scrapping works.

Bonds Guide - Covers what bonds are and how you can gain capital needed for growing your company.

Executives Guide - Goes over what executives are and how they benefit your company.

Time Table - This is a list of times when functions of the game are calculated. Check the list for your local times.

Certificate Explorer - Find all the Certificates available in the game. 

Links to helpful articles from the Sim Times:

Now What? (parts 1 and 2) - An intermediate guide for business planning.

The Do's and Don'ts of Mining

Game Jargon - Identifies the many Acronyms and Abbreviations that are used in game

If you are having problems finding what you want, the Search bar is a useful tool. You can search for Companies (players), Products, Buildings, Guides, and Sim Times Articles.

If you have more questions, please ask in Help Chat. It may even be helpful to just follow along for a while and see what people are asking about. It’s a great way to learn about the game. Join in Game Chat too - for discussions about the game.

Disclaimer: All player-written articles are the opinion (editorial) of that author and do not reflect the opinions and beliefs of Sim Companies or its affiliates (developers, moderators, editors).

By Mighty Moo Inc. & Anonymous

zh-cn.title: 新人指南
zh-cn.body:
由中文区协管翻译

欢迎你到Sim Companies！这本指南会让你学到一些关键游戏和经济模拟器的机制。很多人建议先做游戏教程来学一学怎么生产、购买并零售物资。本指南再仔细看一看。

关于游戏风格，没有”错“的玩法。没有任何“最好”的行业、策略或地图。游戏经济不是固定的，如果有个在6个月以前有效的策略，很可能现在不行。了解游戏，玩的开心，设定自己的目标，观察小变化如何影响大局。


(记得把你的游戏账号绑定您的常用邮箱，避免丢失账号，不要使用假邮箱）
（QQ邮箱已被屏蔽，请使用其他邮箱注册）

第一步 

你公司的首要目标是创收。主要有两种获取收入的方式。

你可以使用生产建筑（比如种植园、农场）生产各种物资，然后使用交易所或合同订单（你必须至少是5等级）与其他公司进行贸易以获得利润。你还可以使用零售建筑来零售一些可零售的物资（比如生鲜商店）。

生产和零售都有各自独特的机制，你可以决定专注于生产，零售，还是两者最适合你的计划。如果你要慢慢理解游戏，建议你同时拥有生鲜商店和中子源、农场，以体验生产和零售。这种农业商业模式还可以确保你一开始能自己赚钱。

公司最初，低等级的公司不能下长时隔夜订单。幸亏，订单时间会随着公司等级增加。根据所有良好的商业常识来说，只要你能获利，你就是走上了正确的道路。

零售建筑

单击建筑，查看可以在生鲜商店里零售的物资以及需求量最大的产品。

  • 你可以通过输入要零售商品的数量和价格来下零售订单。根据你输入的数据，会显示每件商品的平均利润和总时间。

  • 按照平均价格，你可以查看别的公司的零售价格。

  • 你的零售速度会影响你的零售订单花的时间。所花的时间以工资的形式转化为营运成本。

  • 零售速度受到两种因素影响：更高的需求和品质会提高零售速度。

  • 零售价格确定每种商品的利润率。注意到，比较高的价格会降低零售速度，繁殖而然。这也提高每单位的工资成本。你可以计算最合适的价格来使每小时的利润最大。

  • 提示 — 每件商品的平均利润是要考虑的，但是你真正想要找到的是平均小时利润。有时，设定比较低的价格可能会让你获得更大的总利润。以1分钟/单位的速度零售60单位，每单位利润为$2.5，1小时内总计$150；或以1.5分钟/单位的速度零售40单位，每单位$3的利润，1小时内总计$120。

你不需要仔细关注平均价格，这只是有关其他人所零售商品的信息。需求更重要，因为它决定你的零售速度，以及从本质上讲，将使你的单位利润变为多少。假设苹果需求量很高。

获得XP 

建筑忙的时候，你获得XP。如果你要快快升级，保持你的建筑一直忙。

建筑物

建筑物是你公司的核心。你可以建设新的建筑或升级已存在的建筑来为你的公司增加更多价值。

生产和零售建筑以外，有两座你无法升级，拆或换位置的固定建筑：总部（HQ）、和交易所。

建设/建筑升级

建设新建筑是一个增加公司价值的方法。每座建筑让你生产或零售已生产的物资。

升建筑级让你使用同一块地生产或零售更快。

如果你建设错建筑或者换主意，你可以拆建筑。这会退回建筑材料到你的仓库，可以用来建设或升级别的建筑。

注意：1或2级的建筑会返回所有建筑材料。任何3级以上的建筑，你会损失建筑材料。（有关此的更多的信息，请读《建筑业指南》）

总部（HQ）

你的总部建筑是那一座有你的公司名称的建筑，在地图的中间，里面有丰富的关于你的公司财务信息。你可以查看你的公司价值（CV），现金流量和交易。你还会收到利润表的每天更新。你升级的过程中，你会开锁债券（10级）和高管（15级）。

仓库是你可以在其中找到存货和详细信息的地方。单击任何仓库中的物资会显示该物资的成本明细— 分成人工、管理和输入物资成本。你可以在这里选择在交易所上放一批物资，发送合同，在公开档案上显示它们，或暂时禁止它的使用。你还可以查看前5个交易所订单以及你最近进行的任何交易。

要注意的重要事项是运输。在交易所上出售或用合同都需要用运输单位。在以上的情况下，1个橘子需要1个运输单位。每个物资所需的运输单位数可以在你的仓库或百科中找到。合同只需要交易所运输单位数的一半。

无论你选择在交易所上出售还是通过合同，请注意把“隐藏”的运输成本算进去，它不会出现在你的现金收支。

注意：零售在零售建筑里不需要运输单位。

注意：你可以从绿色的现金指标访问总部和仓库。

交易所

交易所是买卖双方买卖物资的地方。

确保在交易所上出售物资时，它是按单价而不是总价输入的。

交易所上的物资以最低的价格列出在顶部（最前面）。比较高品质的物资也会优先于相同价格的比较低品质的物资。同样，交易所顶部的物资会首先出售。更改最低品质（金星星）会仅显示指定品质或更高皮质的物资。

请注意，通过交易所出售的物资会收取一定的交易费用。比如，出售一个价格为$2.00的苹果会收取$0.06的费用和大约$0.35的运输成本，剩下的收入是$1.59。如果你的采购或生产成本不比这低，就出了点问题了！交易费用会影响每种物资的实际利润，因此，在确定出售价格时，尤其是价格比较低的物资（比如沙）时，应该考虑交易费。

你可以通过找到你的列出的物资并单击旁边的“X“来取消交易所订单。如果你在上市后48小时内取消订单，将向你收取一定的费用。48小时后取消不收取任何费。交易所中没被售出的物资将在2周后自动退还到你的仓库。

查看常见问题（FAQ）来了解怎么在交易所上出售你的物资。

合同

合同是什么？合同就是２个玩家之间的物资交易。使用合同之前（发或收），你的公司至少得是５等级。合同也是建议的在公司之间进行交易的方法，因为不像交易所那样收取一定的费用，并且运输是该物资所写数量的一半（请读以下）。

玩家有一些在游戏中找合同的方法。

  1. 买卖聊天室是一个作为买卖的聊天室，也是一个找买/卖家的好地方。

  2. 你可以使用公司标签来搜索每个买/卖任何游戏中物资的公司（访问界面提示“公司标签”）。

  3. 交易所，你可以查看谁在出售某种物资。

你找到了潜在的交易伙伴，可以通过私信于他联系，你们可以协商合同的价格、数量、品质等。

一旦达成协议，合同可以是一次交易，也可以是每日交易（注意，这不是自动的！）

访问常见问题（FAQ）来了解怎么使用合同。

特别提醒：
买家在SimCompanies 游戏内进行买卖交易需谨慎对待 因为这意味着玩家有被欺诈的可能。 在协商价格时，请务必核实合同价格，并核实发送到仓库的价格。 每个人都可以拒绝或取消合同。 如果公司发送了错误的价格，请通过私信联系他们确认协商价格。 如果价格不符合贵公司的标准，每个人都有权在玩家资料中使用忽略功能。 使用忽略功能会阻止收到的合同和私信。

百科

百科是你游戏中的“朋友”。它拥有关游戏中物资的大量信息。了解如何使用百科，经常参考它可以帮助你做出明智的决定。

下面的屏幕快照是新玩家会看到关于苹果的信息。你成长并聘请一个好CFO后，你也会看到一个利润计算。

如何阅读百科清单：

在上面，有生产物资的要求（输入物资）。在以上情况下，每个苹果需要3个水和1个种子。100个苹果需要300水和100种子。

再往下看，有生产苹果的建筑：种植园，还有零售苹果的建筑：生鲜商店。 

下面有生产计算。这会帮助你确定可以生产多少，以及多少升级可以提高产量。调一调设置，看看你的生产和成本如何变化。矿井，采石场和油井的产品具有第4个变量 - 丰度。丰度越高，生产就越快。矿井，采石场和油井每天也损失0.032%的丰度。比较新的公司可以使用85%或更高的丰度，因为他们的管理费用比较低，但公司比较大时，大多数人都寻找95%或更高。你计划保留有丰度建筑的时间越长，要开始的丰度就越高。

零售计算与生产计算类似，但适用于零售建筑。调整这些设置，看看升级如何提高零售速度。这只是使用于可以在商店中零售的物资。

最下面的图标显示零售价格和数量的历史数据。

玩家须知

游戏更新以及新闻

更新日志

玩家可以查看文库内的更新日志。更新日志将按日期记载游戏的更新。

新闻

关于游戏的重大更新将由Patrik，游戏开发者在 Sim Companies时报中发布。每个玩家都会在每周时报发布时得到个人助理（PA）的提醒。关注并查看Patrik发布的内容以随时了解游戏更新。

个人助理 （PA）

想知道个人助理（Personal Assistant，PA）做什么事吗？你的PA会在以下情况下通知你：

  1. 其他公司拒绝的合同

  2. 经济变化

  3. Sim Companies 时报

在游戏初期，你的PA会提出一些于业务相关的问题。你如何回答它们完全取决于你，但是有些选择有好处，有些有后果。它们会帮助你赚取额外的钱并做出良好的业务决策。如果你真的不知道怎么回答，可以在论坛上访问个人助理“任务”（PA Quests）。

确保你回答了每个任务。有时玩家没有得到任务，原因是他们没有回答从PA收到的最后任务。

注意：最新的任务有些先决条件：

  1. 玩的时间

  2. 你的公司有可能损失多少现金（$50,000）

  3. 高管要求（15等级）

Simboosts

Simboosts是什么？Simboosts是蓝色的星星，可以通过每天登录和生产/零售来获得，或者用现实的货币购买。它们可以用来解锁、快速完成并调整一些游戏中的东西。游戏中的现金无法用来购买Simboosts。

这是Simboosts的所有用处的列表。

你可以使用Simboosts来：（建议的顺序）

  1. 解锁四个建筑地块（花50、100、500，500）

  2. 调整生产/零售速度增益（在总部里）

  3. 解锁4个高管/员工空缺（花50、100、200、400）

  4. 维持秀轩建筑：公园、人工湖、城堡（每周花40）

别的Simboosts用处：（无特定顺序）

  • 在Sim Companies时报里广告你的公司

  • 快速完成建筑建设和升级，这样你不需要等待建设/升级完成

  • 快速完成高管培训和招聘

  • 兑换Simboosts成游戏中的现金 - 每天兑换上限为$10,000

  • 解锁展柜空位，可以展示证书、库存、成就

解锁四（4）个建筑地块（Simboosts价格：50、100、500）

新人加速

刚开始玩时，建筑生产、零售、建设和升级被加速一倍，以帮助你开始成长你的公司。利用这个速度增加，让你的建筑一直忙下去。这使生产成本很低。

注意：照片里的时间不会跟你的时间相同。

想创建多个账号来取得优势吗？

突破思维吧？新公司获得大量的启动资金，以使游戏在一开始就充满乐趣。可是，有些玩家试图滥用这一点，来获得不公平的优势，对抗诚实的玩家。

所以禁止拥有多个账号

另外，对于小公司可以以什么价格出售物资受到了更多的限制，无论是交易所还是合同。

游戏中有公平竞争协会。如果某家公司收到的合同或交易所订单的价格跟游戏中平均价格有很大的区别，就很明显并很容易检查。

如果你尝试使用这种方法，你会被盯上。

本指南应该涵盖你直到10级

趁着这段时间学习，看完指南，再回去看一遍。这个游戏很复杂，不要指望一下子就能全部理解游戏的每一方面。就像一个真正的公司，需要花时间来成长并获得经验。PA任务会在初期帮助你，并给你奖励。经常回顾百科将有助于了解物资的相互依存关系。

如果你的建筑一直保持在２级或以下，你拆的时候可以换取满值，然后试一试其他的东西。但是过一会儿或许你会想选择一个行业，专攻。电力是最基本的一个，航空航天是最复杂的。中间还有很多其他选择。只要选择一个看起来有趣的，适合你的风格，然后坚持一段时间就可以了。

无论你决定用什么方法，都要继续努力，优化现金流量。你需要重金来进行实验和探索其他行业。如果你是制造商，你可以试一试找人用合同拿你的物资，这样你就可以节省市场费用。有稳定性也是好事。

同样，如果你是零售商，也可以找一个价格比交易所低的稳定供应商。

指南

文库中有很多有用的指南，在报纸部分以下。建议你阅读这些指南。你会得到更深对游戏机制的理解。论坛也是一个很多关于游戏的信息。

阅读本指南后，请查看文库中的其他一些指南：

常见问题 - 一系列的问题和答案，这些问题对于新人来说非常常见的。

界面提示 - .如何使用游戏中的许多功能。导航栏、聊天、生产/零售、仓库、交易所、总部（HQ）、建筑、笔记和图标。

丰度 - 回顾丰度对资源建筑的含义。

升级和经验获取 - 如何升级并了解什么能提供经验。

研究指南 - 讲什么是研究和品质，以及获得这两者的方法。

建筑业指南 - 包括建设和建筑业，以及怎么建设新建筑，升级已存在的建筑并关于拆建筑的信息。

债券指南 - 讲什么是债券以及如何获得公司发展所需的资金。

高管指南 - 讲关于高管的信息和他们对你的公司的用处和好处。

时间表 - 讲游戏中事情发生的时间，里面有你当地时间。

到Sim时报的有益的文章的链接:

Now What? (parts 1 and 2) - 商业规划的中级指南。（英文）

The Do's and Don'ts of Mining （英文）

Game Jargon - 识别游戏中使用的许多首字母缩略词和缩写 （英文）

到论坛的链接:

Simboosts - 高校利用指南
