en.title: Economy model
en.body:
We want to emulate the environment and decision making a real business owner would have to face. There are multiple sectors and resources in Sim Companies. Their profitability depends on the economy state and actions of other players, and therefore can shift over time.

Being able to spot trends and find opportunities on the market is the key to success.

What is it?

Sim Companies economy engine models buying behavior of the "general public". Selling properties of products and goods (such as apples, sausages, etc.) retailable in the retail buildings are guided by this model. The economy engine's goal is to simulate behavior that you would expect in the real world. Understanding the buying behavior of the "general public" allows players to develop strategies that maximize their profit. Once a day, the model accounts for goods sold in retail in whole economy and based on saturation of individual products, the demand for the next day is determined.

The demand dictates how quickly the product sells in retail.

For more detailed information on how the saturation/demand, selling price, and quality of the product influences the selling speed read:

Selling time vs. profit

Sim Companies uses a polynomial function to simulate an increase in selling time with increase in selling price. This article will look at the actual values the model uses for apples for demonstration. The first chart describes the relationship between selling time in seconds and retail price for both high demand (blue) and low demand (red).

Note: The current market demand can be seen in the encyclopedia or in the building that sells the product.

Building salaries (and profit per unit sold)

Reviewing the data, it might look as if the easiest way to maximize your profit is to sell at higher price. However, employees in your retail shop (grocery store, gas station, etc.) are being paid while the store is selling. So, the longer it takes for you to sell the product the more you spend on wages. We need to look at our profit, the next chart adds the grocery store wages into the equation and subtracts it from the apples revenue.

Maximum resource utilization

Another way of looking at the data is to check how to maximize profit per unit time, instead of the product unit. As players have a limited number of retail buildings available, these need to be used efficiently. We have also neglected the sourcing cost of the apples. We should also plug in the base cost of one unit of apple since it has to be obtained. The last chart assumes production cost of an apple of $2.4 and displays the profit per hour.

zh-cn.title: 经济模拟模型
zh-cn.body:
由Silverman AG翻译

经济模拟模型到底是什么？

 

Sim Companies经济对“普通大众”的购买行为进行建模。可零售产品（如苹果、香肠等）的零售属性是由这个模型决定的。该经济模型的目标是模拟你在现实世界中的行为。了解“普通大众”的购买行为，使玩家能够制定策略，使他们的利润最大化。这可以通过回答以下问题来简化：在我的价格和当前的零售需求下，我可以多快地卖出货物？

零售时间

 

Sim Companies使用一个多项式函数来模拟零售时间随零售价格的增加而增加。本文将研究该模型对苹果的实际数值进行演示。第一个图表描述了正常需求（红色）和极端需求（蓝色）下零售时间（秒）和零售价格之间的关系。

注意：你可以在各自零售建筑或百科里查看商品需求。

建筑工资

 

看了这些数据，似乎使你的利润最大化的最简单方法是以更高的价格零售。然而，你的零售店（生鲜商店、加油站等）的工人在店内零售的同时也在领取工资。因此，你零售商品的时间越长，你在工资上的支出就越多。下一个图表将生鲜商店的工资加入到这个等式中。根据这些数字，一个苹果的最大利润零售价是$6。

高效的资源利用

 

看待数据的另一种方式是将每单位时间的利润最大化。由于玩家可用的零售建筑（地块）数量有限，这些建筑需要有效地使用。我们还可以插入一个苹果的基本成本，因为它尽量廉价生产。最后一张图表假设市场正常饱和，生产成本为$2.40，并显示了建筑每小时的利润。

en.title: Executives guide
en.body:
EXECUTIVES (Unlocked at level 15)

In the real world, companies hire officers to fill specific roles. Below are the executives' roles that could be filled in Sim Companies and what their benefit would be:

Chief Operations Officer

  • A good COO decreases administrative costs by a percentage ( % ), decreasing the companies cost of production and retail. (Administration overhead)

Chief Financial Officer

  • A good CFO decreases accounting overhead. The threshold where accounting fees start to be applied is moved up. (Accounting fees starting at)

Chief Marketing Officer

  • A good CMO decreases the selling time in retail which increases profit. He also ensures your restaurants get better ratings. (Sales Speed)

Chief Technical Officer

  • A good CTO increases the probability of research points being accepted as patents. (Patent probability)  

  • The CTO increases research speeds. (Research production speed increase)

Administration overhead: 19.41% minus 4.08% = 15.33% (actual overhead, note player profiles only show the first % )
Accounting fees starting at: $3M plus $13.0M = $16 million (increases accounting overhead see FAQ )
This table is located in the executives tab.

TALENTS AND SKILLS

There are 4 skills:

Management (COO)

Accounting (CFO)

Communication (CMO)

Science (CTO)

Each candidate starts with the skills being fairly low, but as you train them and as they gain experience working at a specific role, the skills will improve. Executives working as "staff", not assigned to a specific role, are getting experience towards all 4 skills.

The rate of improvement is determined by their 4 talents (one talent for each skill). The talents are hidden, but can be observed indirectly by how quickly the skill raises. The talents do not change over time.

The employees at COO, CFO, CMO, and CTO positions are contributing to your company's performance as described earlier. Your COO's management skills contribute towards lower administration cost the most, however, the management skills of other 3 executives contributes slightly as well. Same goes for other 3 positions.

HIRING

Hiring executives is unlocked at level 15.

Note: It is highly suggested you understand the costs involved with hiring executives. Just because you can hire executives does not mean you should hire executives. (Most players wait until 20% administration overhead before hiring).

Executives can be hired as fresh candidates from a University. Or they can be poached from other companies using hiring agencies.

You can have your HR department look for fresh graduates, or you can use one of the 3 hiring agencies to help you get the right executive. The agencies will charge you fee if the executive decided to work for you.

If you decide to use one of 3 hiring agencies you will be offered a candidate based on your requirements, either unemployed, or working for one of the other companies. Based on the information give you can decide to reject the candidate or proceed with the offer.

The information about a person who is not working for you yet is very limited. For students of University with no previous working experience - you will get a free text assessment from your HR department. For candidates with existing working experience (at other companies) you will see a brief info about their work experience and training. A single executive cannot receive more than 20 training.

Helpful information added via the Sim Companies Forum:
An Executive Guide

You cannot give offers to executives of other companies directly. The experienced executives can be hired only using agencies. Once an offer is placed, the executive gets back to you with an answer within 26 hours. You need to pay for all training the executive has received within the last 6 weeks ($30,000 per training). Training that was received before an executive was fired do not have to be paid for.

If your executive is given a 3rd party offer, there are few scenarios:

  • The offer is too low and your employee does not even consider taking it. You will not even find out an offer was placed.

  • The offer is high and interesting to your executive.

    • In the case of an offer higher than 33% the current salary, an option to increase the salary will be visible. In order to keep an Executive, you need to match 75% of the offered salary, which is calculated for you automatically. If you're not paying them that much already, you'll see a button to give them a raise to that amount.

    • When offer from the other company is lower than twice the current salary you don't need to raise it, the executive will stay unless you let him go.

    You can either let the Executive go to the 3rd party or wait the 26 hour period. There will be a timer on executive screen showing how much time you have left before they leave. Even if the executive decides to leave, it might not happen if the offering company doesn't have funds.

  • When your executive leaves for another company you will receive a part of his salary as royalties. Royalties are based on how long the Exec worked for you and their offered salary. There will be no royalty payment if the exec is fired, however payments will continue if they are re-hired from the Unemployment Pool.

How to make sure your executives do not leave? Make sure you pay them what they are worth. Salary raises are not needed when the Executive has no offer from another company and you can not increase executives salary whenever you want.

ACADEMY AND APRENTICES


The academy is a special building that makes executives’ training more effective, and increases the starting statistics of in-house candidates. The more academy levels, the higher the contribution. Furthermore, every 5 levels of the academy, apprentice positions are unlocked for major executive positions.

You can own multiple academies at the same time, their levels are combined. Bonuses are calculated from the sum of the academy levels owned.

Note: Academy adds to administrative overhead, and make no XP.

Directors in apprentice positions contribute to your company's performance, but with some limitations:
Only half of apprentices' skills are counted
Only the apprentice skills needed for the position are counted, the other skills have no impact. (Example: Communication skills are not counted in a COO apprentice position)
You can unlock up to 4 additional apprentice slots, one each for COO, CFO, CMO and CTO.

Note: When you have apprentices assigned, you cannot have less academy levels than are required to unlock them

STAFF

Staff (other directors) are employees that do not add any benefit to the executive positions (COO, CFO, CMO, CTO).

You can use the staff positions to train an employee to replace a retiring or poached executive. Training takes twenty-seven (27) hours and $10,000.

Employees positions can change positions with each other. To do this, select Move.

The options to change the position will show under the Executive. Selecting any of the positions will move them to that location. This will switch the positions of both executives.

Note: changing a staff member to an executive position takes 3 hours for the employee to settle into their new position.

EXPENSES

You need to pay your executives daily. The salary is known when you are hiring. Other expenses you can have are: training ($10,000), severance package if you decide to dismiss your executive (3 days worth of salary). You may also need to make salary counter-offers if other company tries to poach your employees.

Your executives are being paid daily automatically. If there's no cash to cover the salaries, they will strike.

TRAINING

You do have the option to train executives. Whether they gain skills or not from training is dependent on their underlying talent. There is no guarantee that the training will result in the expected skill point gain.

Each training takes 27 hours and costs $10,000.

The categories to train are as follows:

  • Management training (management skills) (COO)

  • Accounting seminar (accounting skills) (CFO)

  • Communication workshop (communication skills) (CMO)

  • Science conference (science skills) (CTO)

  • Wide range skills lessons (management, accounting, communication, science)

The max amount of training per executive is 20 sessions.

tips:
If you have a candidate you are not sure what they are skilled in; use wide range of skills on new hires to find out their strengths.
If you are sure they are skilled; start training in that category (example: 2 skills in management; start training in management).

If, they do not gain skills in 2 to 4 training sessions; fire them and look for a new candidate.

EXPERIENCE

Executives can earn experience over time and can gain skills without training. Executives in the main positions (COO, CFO, CMO, CTO) have a higher chance of earning skills based on those positions. As an example: COO’s have a higher chance of earning Management skills.

Experience can be earned daily (not guaranteed).

14:00 UTC - Executives experience
”Executives gain their experience skills, based on their position and how long they been there.”

See the Time Table for your local time.

LIMITS ON EXECUTIVES’ EFFECTIVENESS

To balance the gameplay and prevent from over- exploiting executives potential, there have been set limitations.

Sum of effective skill point from the chief director, apprentice, and other directors above a total of 60 points will be divided by 2, and above 80 points will be added in 1/4 only. The image below shows how the effective points are counted.

EXECUTIVE GROWING OLD

Executive employees would grow old and retire at some point. They grow older by 1 year every 2 days. The more they are earning, the higher chance they retire sooner.
Note: Players who are inactive are protected and their executives no longer age, and cannot be poached.

When executives become older there is a risk that they will suffer a stroke, which reduces their skills.

NOTIFICATION CENTER

To make executives management easier, all related events will be noted in the notification center. The notification center is located on the top navigation bar and is marked with a bell icon.
Clicking on notifications from the list will automatically redirect you to the screen of the director to whom the notification refers.
Some of the notifications, such as retirement notice, are sent in advance. This will allow your company to prepare for the upcoming event.

EXTRA EXECUTIVES AND STAFF INFORMATION

Quick reference:

Candidates: 10 hours

Settle In:  3 hours

Training Cost:  $10,000, 27 hours, 20 trainings

Extra Staff Slot: 50, 100, 200, 400, 500

Extra Apprentice Slot: every 5 levels of Academy

Severance Package Days: 3

Strike: 24 hours

Salaries Paid: 04:00 UTC

Retiring Executives: 08:00 UTC

Experience: 14:00 UTC


Explanation:

Finding Candidates takes 10 hours
Settling in to a new Executive position takes 3 hours

Training Cost is $10,000 and 27 hours, with 20 max training sessions

Severance Packages are 3 days worth of salary

The extra Staff slots cost: 50, 100, 200, 400, 500 (Sim Boosts)

Extra Apprentice slots are unlocked when reaching 5, 10, 15, 20 levels of Academy in total

A Strike lasts for 24 hours:

  • If you don’t have money to pay for your executives/staff they will go on strike.

  • No benefits will be applied from executives while on strike.

  • Any training will continue during a strike.

  • Two (2) days in a row of a strike; the executive(s) will leave your company.

Salaries are paid out automatically at 04:00 UTC. See Time Table for your local time.

Executives retire at 08:00 UTC. See Time Table for your local time.

Executives can earn experience daily at 14:00 UTC. See Time Table for your local time.

HOW TO USE THE EXECUTIVES WISELY

Make sure each executive you have is making your company more money than the daily salary you pay them. Always be on a lookout for a good hire and HAVE FUN!

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times (listed by date):
Understanding the Boardroom - Part 1 - The Value of Executives (newspaper 13)

Understanding the Boardroom - Part 2 - Prospecting for Talent (newspaper 13)

How Much Do Executives Cost? What Do They Give Me?

Genie of the Lamp: The Power of Science (CTO and Patents)

Filling the Executive Gap- A Guide for Beginners

The Tax Man Cometh (Accounting Overhead)

Fantastic COO and how to evaluate them

Training: Develop Top Executives Yourself Instead of Poaching (Part 1) (newspaper 328)

Training: Develop Top Executives Yourself Instead of Poaching (Part 2-1) (newspaper 329)

Training: Develop Top Executives Yourself Instead of Poaching (Part 2-2) (newspaper 329)

Training: Develop Top Executives Yourself Instead of Poaching (Part 3) (newspaper 330)

zh-cn.title: 高管指南
zh-cn.body:
正在修订中，英语部分为修订内容

由中文区协管 KINGMAKER 翻译

高管 (15级时解锁)

在现实世界中，公司雇用高管来担任特定的角色。以下是在Sim Companies中可以担任的高管角色，以及他们可以给你的公司带来的好处。

首席运营官（COO）

  • 一位好的COO可以减少你的管理费用百分比（％），因此减少了生产和零售成本。（管理费用）

首席财务官（CFO）

  • 一位好的CFO减少会计费用。CFO上移开始付会计费用的门槛。(会计费用产生于)

首席营销官（CMO）

  • 一位好的CMO增加零售速度，因此提高利润。（零售速度）

首席技术官（CTO）

  • 一位好的CTO可以增加研究点转化为专利的概率。(专利转化概率）

上图显示的是一个没有使用高管福利的情况。
下图显示的是一个使用高管福利的情况。

管理费用：46.47% - 14.41% = 32.06%（真正管理费用；注意，玩家档案只显示第一个百分比）
会计费用产生于（现金与债券水平）：$3M + 7.0M = $10.0M（上移开始付会计费用的门槛，参见常见问题（FAQ））
这个信息表位于你的高管人员下面的高管标签中。

才能和技能

有4种技能：

  • 管理 (COO)

  • 会计 (CFO)

  • 沟通 (CMO)

  • 科学 (CTO)

每个高管开始时的技能都相当低，但随着你对他/她的培训和获得在特定角色工作的经验，技能将得到提高。作为“员工”工作的高管，没有被分配到一个特定的角色，可以获得所有4种技能的经验。

提高的速度由他们的4个天赋决定（每个技能有一个天赋）。天赋是隐藏的，但可以通过每个技能的增长速度来间接观察。天赋不会随着时间的推移而改变。

如前所述，在COO、CFO、CMO和CTO职位上的高管直接使你的公司受益。你的COO的管理技能减少管理费用的最多，然而，其他三个高管的管理技能也有一定的贡献。其他三个职位也是如此。

高管每点有效数值对照表

职位 每 1 点有效技能 效果说明
COO (Management) −1% 管理费率 减少总管理费用的绝对值百分点
CFO (Accounting) +$500K 会计上限 提高会计费用起征门槛
CMO (Communication) +0.333% 销售速度 3 点 = +1% 销售速度
CMO (Communication) +0.01 餐馆评级 每点提升 0.01 餐馆评级
CTO (Science) +0.0625% 专利概率 基础概率 6.25% × 1%，10点 = 6.875%
CTO (Science) +2% 研究速度 研究类建筑生产速度提升

聘请

高管的聘请在15级时解锁。

注意： 强烈建议你考虑聘请高管所涉及的成本。仅仅因为你可以聘请高管，并不一定意味着你应该聘请高管。 （很多玩家要等到达到20%管理费用才会开始聘请高管）

高管们可以从大学里作为应聘者被聘用。或者，他们可以通过猎头机构从其他公司挖来。

你可以让你的人力资源部门寻找大学毕业生，或者你可以使用3家猎头机构中的一家来帮助你找到合适的高管。如果高管决定为你工作，这些机构将向你收取费用。

如果你决定使用3家猎头机构中的一家，你将根据你的参数得到一个候选人，他要么是失业的，要么是为其他公司工作的。根据所提供的信息，你可以决定拒绝该候选人或继续提供报价。

关于不为你工作的高管的信息非常有限。对于大学毕业生，你会从你的HR部门得到一个简短的文字评估。对于以前有工作经验的候选人（在其他公司），你会得到一个关于他们工作经验和培训的简短信息简介。

一位高管不能接受超过20次的培训。

来自Sim Companies论坛的更多有关的信息：
An Executive Guide

你无法直接向在其他公司工作的高管发出邀请。目前在职的高管只能通过中介机构来雇用。一旦发出薪酬报价，高管将在24小时内接受或拒绝。你需要支付该高管在过去6周内接受的所有培训（每次培训得付$20,000）。你不需要为失业的高管所接受的培训付费。

如果你的高管得到了第三方的报价，有几种情况：

  • 第一：薪酬报价太低，你的高管甚至不考虑接受。你甚至不会发现到有人提出了报价。

  • 第二：薪酬报价高，对你的高管来说很有意思。在这种情况下可能会发生两件事情：

    • 这位高管很忠诚，想留下来。该薪酬报价被拒绝，你甚至不会发现发生了这种情况。(10%的概率)

    • 这位高管正在认真考虑接受该薪酬报价，但你不知道该提议的细节（除了薪酬）。你可以通过调整你的高管的薪酬来做出反应。

    你可以让高管离开去为第三方公司工作，或者等待24小时的时间。 认真考虑离开的高管会根据报价的大小和目前在你的公司得到的薪酬做出最终决定。即使高管决定离开，如果发出报价的公司没有足够现金来支付招聘费用，也不会发生。

如何确保你的高管不离开？确保你付给他们合理的薪酬，特别是在他们经常收到薪酬报价的情况下。你可以在任何时间增加（但无法降低）高管的工资。

学院是一种特殊建筑，能使高管的培训更加有效，并提高自培候选人的初始属性。学院等级越高，加成越大。此外，学院每达到 5 级，就会为主要的行政职位解锁一个学徒岗位。

你可以同时拥有多间学院，它们的等级会叠加计算。加成效果基于所有学院的总等级。

注意：学院会增加管理费，且不产生经验（XP）。

担任学徒岗位的高管也会为你的公司做出贡献，但有一些限制：

  • 学徒的技能只按 50% 计算
  • 只有该岗位所需的技能才会被计入，其他技能不产生影响。（例如：沟通技能不会计入 COO 学徒岗位的贡献）
  • 最多可以解锁 4 个额外的学徒岗位，分别对应 COO、CFO、CMO 和 CTO。

注意：一旦分配了学徒，你的学院总等级不得低于解锁该学徒岗位所需的最低等级。

职员

职员是指得对高管职位（COO、CFO、CMO、CTO）没有任何益处的雇员。

你可以利用职员职位来培训高管，以取代即将退休或被挖走的高管。培训需要27小时和$10,000。

高管们可以换职位。要做到这一点，选择转岗。

所有会议室的职位都将显示在该高管以下。选择任何一个职位都会把高管移到那个职位。如果职位已经被占用，这将切换两位高管的职位。

注意：被调换到高管（非职员）职位的高管需要3小时来“交接”新职位。

费用

你需要向你的高管支付日薪。薪酬甚至在雇用之前就已经知道了。你可能产生的其他费用有：培训（每次培训$10,000），如果你决定解雇你的高管（3天的薪酬），则需要提供离职补偿。如果其他公司试图挖走你的高管，你也可能需要增加薪酬。

高管的薪酬是每天自动支付的。如果没有足够的现金来支付薪酬，所有高管将罢工24小时。

培训

你可以培训你的高管。他们是否从培训中获得技能，取决于他们的基本天赋。无法保证培训会带来预期的技能点增加。

每次培训需要27小时而花$10,000。

每种类型的培训列举如下：

  • 管理培训（管理技能）(COO)

  • 会计课程（会计技能）(CFO)

  • 沟通工作室（沟通技能）(CMO)

  • 科学界研讨会（科学技能）(CTO)

  • 各领域课程（管理、会计、沟通和科学）

每位高管只能接受20次培训。

提示：你可以使用各领域课程来发现新高管的天赋。如果他们不在2到4次培训内获得任何技能，你应该立即解雇，然后寻找新候选人。

经验

高管们可以随着时间的推移赚取经验，并且可以自然而然地获得技能，而无需培训。 担任主要职位（COO、CFO、CMO、CTO）的高管有更多机会获得与这些职位相对应的技能。例如：COO有较高的机会获得管理技能。
经验可以每天获得（不保证）。

访问时间表，来看更多信息。

为了平衡游戏性并防止过度利用高管的潜力，系统设定了以下限制。

首席高管、学徒以及其他高管的有效技能点总和：超过 60 点的部分按 1/2 折算，超过 80 点的部分仅按 1/4 折算。下图展示了有效点数的计算方式。

有效点数衰减

累计有效点数 贡献比例 公式
0 – 60 100% 全额计入
60 – 80 50% 60 + (点数 − 60) ÷ 2
80 以上 25% 60 + (80 − 60) ÷ 2 + (点数 − 80) ÷ 4，即 70 + (点数 − 80) ÷ 4

高管衰老


高管会逐渐衰老，并最终在某个时间点退休。每 2 天，他们的年龄增加 1 岁。薪资越高的高管，越有可能提前退休。 注意：不活跃的玩家会受到保护，其高管不再衰老，也无法被挖角。

当高管年纪变大后，有中风的风险，中风会降低他们的技能。

通知中心

为了更方便地管理高管，所有相关事件都会记录在通知中心中。通知中心位于顶部导航栏，以铃铛图标标记。 点击列表中的通知，将自动跳转到该通知所涉及的高管页面。 某些通知（如退休通知）会提前发送，以便你的公司为即将到来的事件做好准备。


更多高管信息

快速参考信息：

候选人寻找：10个小时

交接新职位：3个小时

培训:  $10,000，27个小时，最多20次培训

职员职位: 50、100、200、400、500个simboosts

遣散费：3天的薪酬

薪酬支付时间：04:00 UTC - 访问时间表

获得经验时间：14:00 UTC - 访问时间表

如果你没有足够的现金支付高管/职员的薪酬，他们将罢工。

罢工期间，高管的所有加成效果将失效。

罢工期间，任何正在进行的培训仍会继续。

连续罢工两（2）天，高管将离开你的公司。


高管精疲力竭（Stroke）

| 项目 | 数值 |
|------|------|
| 触发年龄 | ≥ 60 岁 |
| 检查时间 | 每日 08:00 UTC（GMT+8 16:00） |

| 重复触发 | 可，每天最多 1 次 |
| 可恢复 | 否 |

> ⚠️ 60 岁门槛、30% 比例、不可恢复。

如何明智地使用高管

确保每位高管节省的钱比他们的日薪多。始终注意寻找好的候选人，并享受高管其中的乐趣！

en.title: Government orders
en.body:
Maintained by The Center

When the government needs to buy resources from the private sector, the players, it uses Government Orders (GO) to do so. You can think of these as tenders or procurement. To ensure fair order assignment, and cheap fulfillment, the government uses a form of auction, when picking which company to assign the order to.

The companies that want to bid for the government orders need to form teams of 3 to 7 contractors, and apply together creating a Government Order Bid.

Tiers

Depending on your company size, you are assigned to a Tier. in general, the higher the tier number the more resources you need to deliver to fulfill the order, however, the number of your team members, contractors, on your application and their tier also determines how much you are delivering.

The Tier of the largest contractor on the Bid determines the tier of the bid, and resource amounts that have to be delivered. If there are low-tier contractors, the higher tier contractors have to backfill their part.

The bid screen shows exactly how much each contractor has to deliver.

The “per unit of” means the price the Government is going to pay for each resource when the Government Order is awarded. In the image below “per unit of Sneakers Q1” with $19; means the Government will pay the team members $19 for Q1 Sneakers. Will pay $31 for Q0 Dress. Will pay $10 per Q3 Underwear. Will pay $10 for Q3 Fabric.


Reward

The main contractor, the company that is creating the Government Order Bid, determines what compensation the team is getting for each resource. The reward is split between the contractors depending on the amounts they are delivering based of their respective Tier.

Government Order bids with low buyout prices are awarded first.

The reward is paid if the Government Order Bid was awarded and the contractor delivers the required amount. The reward is paid right away on the delivery, even if other contractors did not fulfill their part.

Deposit

The deposit makes sure contractors take their Government Order Bid seriously. You risk losing it if the whole Government Order Bid is not fulfilled. The deposit amount depends on your Tier and the number of applicants on the Government Order Bid.

Deposits are taken automatically when Government Order Bids are awarded. If any bidder on the Government Order Bid can't put down the deposit, the whole Government Order Bid is disqualified.

You can put down the deposit before the awarding time. This makes sure it is paid and shows the other bidders on your Government Order Bid that you are serious. If you are removed from the Government Order Bid before awarding, the deposit is returned to you.

If you pay the deposit upfront and the required deposit later increases, the remaining amount will be taken automatically at the awarding time.

Deposits for awarded Government Order Bids are returned once all bid participants fulfill their part.

Fulfillment

Once the bid; you are contractor on is awarded, you can simply click to deliver the resources against it. The reward is paid immediately. The deposit is returned once all contractors on your bid deliver.

There is a time limit, in days, on how much time you have to deliver against the order.

The quality shown on the items is the minimum quality that is needed.
If Q1 is listed you can fulfill the order with Q1+
If Q2 is listed you can fulfill the order with Q2+
and so on

What resources is the government buying?

The government needs resources across all industries and in high quantities and certain qualities. The examples are 700 trucks for the Fire Department. 20,000 laptops for the IRS offices. Some orders may combine multiple different resources: 120,000 apples and 200,000 oranges for the Foreign Relief Office, or 300,000 units of petrol and 500,000 units of diesel for National Reserves.

The amounts are determined by the tier and split between contractors on your bid.

Where to find Government Orders?

Government Orders are located on the Exchange. They have their own section found in the Building icon on the far right of the top row.

The selection (awarding) process

New government orders are published periodically and there is a 5-day window in which companies can team up and place their bids. You can determine how much you want in return for delivering, what price you are delivering at. The bid remains secret and can be changed or cancelled anytime up to 24 hours before the bidding period ends.

A multiple of Government Order Bids can be accepted and orders awarded, until certain percentage of applications was considered, or amount the government needs was ordered. You can assume 50% - 70% of bidding teams will be awarded.

The bids with the lowest price win, obviously, the government wants to save money.

Once the awarding is done, the government publishes the amount which was ordered in all awarded bids.

Risks and considerations

Make sure you know your partners you are entering the Government Order Bid. The more companies you have on the application, the less you have to deliver. While the benefits are great, there are risks you should be aware of:

  • If one of the other contractors does not have cash to cover their deposit, your bid is not considered and awarded.

  • If one of the other contractors doesn’t deliver, you lose your deposit.

  • The main contractor, the company that set up the bid, can attempt to change bid prices without discussing it with you.

Recap

  • Your company must be level 20+ to apply.

  • You need to form teams/bids with 3-7 companies.

  • The lower your price (bid), the higher chance your bid will be awarded.

  • You need to be have cash for the deposit ready when the bids are being considered for awarding.

  • The deposits are only taken if you WIN the bid. If any of the contractors doesn’t have enough cash, the whole bid is disqualified so there will be no need to pay the deposit.

  • You need to fulfill in time to get reward.

  • Every contractor on your bid needs to fulfill in time for anyone to get the deposit back.

  • Can apply to one team per Government Order.

  • 13:00 UTC - New government orders posted (Wednesday)

  • 13:00 UTC - Government orders awarded (Monday)

  • Bids are locked 24 hours before the bid ending period. This is to protect sub-contractors from last minute bid changes.

zh-cn.title: 政府订单指南
zh-cn.body:
由The Center维护 / 由Silverman AG, SweetPotato（新版）翻译

当政府需要从私营部门（玩家）购买资源时，它会发出政府订单（GO）。你可以把这些看作是招标或采购。为了确保公平的订单分配和廉价的采购，政府在选择承包商时采用投标的形式。

想要竞标政府订单的公司需要组成3至7个承包商的团队，并共同申请政府订单竞标。

 

 

等级

根据你公司的规模，你将被分配到不同的等级。一般来说，等级越高，完成订单需要交付的资源就越多。但是，你的团队成员、承包商的数量以及他们的等级也决定了你交付的数量。

投标中最大的承包商的等级决定了该投标的总等级，以及必须交付的资源量。如果有低等级的承包商，则较高级的承包商必须填补他们的部分。

投标页面准确显示了每个承包商必须交付多少。

The “per unit of” means the price the Government is going to pay for each resource when the Government Order is awarded. In the image below “per unit of Sneakers Q1” with $19; means the Government will pay the team members $19 for Q1 Sneakers. Will pay $31 for Q0 Dress. Will pay $10 per Q3 Underwear. Will pay $10 for Q3 Fabric.

PHOTO 5

奖金

主承包商，即创建政府订单投标申请的公司，决定团队为每种资源获得的报酬。根据承包商各自等级交付的数量，奖励在承包商之间分配。

政府订单投标价格低的将首先中标。

如果政府订单投标中标并且承包商交付了所需数量，则支付奖励。即使其他承包商没有交付他们的部分，也会在交付时立即支付（你的）奖励。

保证金

保证金用于确保承包商认真对待自己的政府订单投标。如果整个政府订单投标没有完成，你可能会失去保证金。保证金金额取决于你的等级，以及该政府订单投标中的申请人数。

当政府订单投标中标时，系统会自动收取保证金。如果该政府订单投标中的任何投标人无法支付保证金，整个政府订单投标都会被取消资格。

你可以在中标结算时间之前提前支付保证金。这样可以确保保证金已支付，也能向同一政府订单投标中的其他投标人表明你是认真的。如果你在中标前被移出该政府订单投标，保证金会退还给你。

如果你提前支付了保证金，但之后所需保证金增加，剩余金额会在中标结算时间自动扣除。

已中标的政府订单投标会在所有投标参与者完成各自部分后退还保证金。

交付

一旦你参加的申请中标，你只需单击即可交付相应资源。奖励将立即支付。一旦你所在投标的所有承包商都交付，保证金将退还。

交付订单的时间有限制，以天为单位。

Once the bid; you are contractor on is awarded, you can simply click to deliver the resources against it. The reward is paid immediately. The deposit is returned once all contractors on your bid deliver.

There is a time limit, in days, on how much time you have to deliver against the order.

The quality shown on the items is the minimum quality that is needed.
If Q1 is listed you can fulfill the order with Q1+
If Q2 is listed you can fulfill the order with Q2+
and so on

PHOTO

政府正在购买哪些资源？

政府需要各行各业的大量且具有特定品质的资源。例如，消防部门需要 700 辆卡车。国税局需要 20,000 台笔记本电脑。有些订单可能结合了多种不同的资源：外国救济办公室需要 120,000 个苹果和 200,000 个橙子，国家储备需要 300,000 单位汽油和 500,000 单位柴油。

数量由等级决定，并在你的投标中由承包商分摊。

PHOTO

要在哪里找到政府订单？

政府订单页面可以在交易所里找到。它们位于顶行最右侧的建筑图标中。 

 选择（中标/授权）流程

新的政府订单会定期发布，并且有 5 天的时间让公司组队并投标。你可以确定交付的“回报金额”以及交付价格。投标将保密，并且可以在投标期结束前随时更改或取消。

多个政府订单投标会被接受并授予订单；直到考虑了一定比例的申请，或者政府得到了需要的数量。

你可以假设 50% - 70% 的竞标团队将中标。

出价最低的投标获胜，显然，政府希望省钱。

一旦中标，政府就会公布所有中标投标中订购的数量。

风险和注意事项

确保你了解你正在参加政府订单投标的合作伙伴。申请中的公司越多，你需要交付的越少。虽然好处很多，但你应该注意以下风险：

  • 如果其他承包商之一没有足够的现金来支付他们的保证金，你的投标将不予考虑和授予。

  • 如果其他承包商之一没有交付，你（以及全队成员）将失去保证金。

  • 主承包商，即设置投标的公司，可以尝试更改投标价格而无需与你讨论。

 回顾

  • 公司等级必须是20级以上才能投标

  • 你需要与3-7家公司组成团队/投标。

  • 你的价格（投标）越低，中标（被选中）的机会就越大。

  • 在考虑中标时，你需要准备好足够的现金作为保证金。

  • The deposits are only taken if you WIN the bid. If any of the contractors doesn’t have enough cash, the whole bid is disqualified so there will be no need to pay the deposit.

  • 你需要及时交付才能获得奖励。

  • 你投标中的每个承包商都需要及时交付，以便每个人都能拿回保证金。

  • Can apply to one team per Government Order.

  • 13:00 UTC - New government orders posted (Wednesday)

  • 13:00 UTC - Government orders awarded (Monday)

  • Bids are locked 24 hours before the bid ending period. This is to protect sub-contractors from last minute bid changes.

en.title: Leveling and Experience Gain
en.body:
What is covered in this guide:

  1. Operating Buildings and Recreation Buildings

  2. Level Breakdown

  3. New Construction

  4. Abundance Buildings (Quarry, Mine, Oil Rig)

  5. Upgrading Buildings

  6. Sales Offices

Operating Buildings and Recreation Buildings

Experience is gained from running your buildings and recreation buildings.   Idle buildings do NOT gain experience.  

12 experience per hour per building
40 experience per hour per level for recreation building

(Note: you will not get the experience from the recreation building until the 7 days are complete).

Buildings

12 experience per hour per building

12 experience x 1 hour = 12 experience
12 experience x 12 hours = 144 experience

If you have 2 buildings that now changes to 24 experience per hour
If you have 5 buildings that now changes to 60 experience per hour
...and so on...

Recreation Building (park, castle, lake):

40 experience/hour/level 

There are 168 hours in 1 week.  Recreation buildings run off of Sim Boosts for 1 week (168 hours).   Need to run recreation buildings for all 168 hours to gain the experience.

en.title: Realms
en.body:
What is Realms?
Realms allows players to control 2 companies in 2 different universes.
1 company in Magnates Realm and 1 company in Entrepreneurs Realm.
Your Magnates Realm company remains the same (does not reset) when you start the new company in Entrepreneurs Realm.

What are the Major differences between the two Realms?
The Magnates Realm is the original Sim Companies game with all the industries unlocked and players can start their businesses and dream big.

The Entrepreneurs Realm is a new world with limited industries and as time progresses more industries and features will be added to relive the Magnates experience of the game.

Notes:

Trading between realms is not possible. They are 2 separate universes. No way to transfer money or products.

Magnates Realm is sometimes referred to as R1
Entrepreneurs Realm is sometimes referred to as R2

How to switch to the other realm?

Select the M at the top of the game by the menu options.

A selection will appear where you can select the realm you want to visit.

Once you have visited the Entrepreneurs realm you can return to the Magnates realm by selecting the E to return to the Realm selection.

Unread messages will show up at the top by the Realm logo. This indicates you have unread messages in the the other realm.

The example below shows 5 unread messages in the Entrepreneurs realm

zh-cn.title: 领域
zh-cn.body:
由 中文区协管 KINGMAKER 翻译

什么是领域？
领域允许玩家们在两个服务器中同时控制两个公司。

一个公司在商业大亨领域，一个公司在企业家领域。
当你在企业家领域开始新的公司时，你的 "商业大亨领域 "公司将保持不变（不会重置）。

这两个领域的主要区别是什么？
商业大亨领域是原始的模拟公司游戏，所有的行业都已解锁，玩家可以开始他们的业务和梦想。

企业家领域是一个新的世界，产业有限，随着时间的推移，更多的产业和功能将被添加，以重温游戏中的商业大亨体验。

注意：领域之间的交易是不可能的。 它们是两个独立的服务器。 无法转移任何金钱或产品。

如何切换到另一个领域？

在游戏顶部的菜单选项中选择M。

通过此链接，你可以选择你想访问的领域。

一旦你访问了企业家领域，你可以通过选择E返回境界选择来返回商业大亨领域。

如何增加新的产业？

新行业及其原物料将通过阶段性增加。每个阶段将持续3至8周，取决于市场的反应和他们的零售饱和度。

en.title: Reference prices and market limits
en.body:
The prices at which players can post market orders and contracts are limited. This has multiple reasons:

  • Fat fingers check - a sensible game should not let you post your products at ridiculously low or high prices by accident. These limits are referred to as fat finger checks, indicating, that a person may accidentally hit more keyboard keys than intended

  • Cheating prevention - we want to avoid easy funneling of cash between “friendly” companies. This can be done by selling and/or buying products at ridiculous prices. While we have other mechanisms to detect this: http://www.simcompanies.com/fpa, it’s still better to avoid it in the first place.

Achieving this is not trivial since we have a lively economy and prices of resources are not stable. We have fluctuations due to Economic shifts, Contests, Government Orders, and Market manipulations. The limits should not prevent companies from running their usual operation.

Currently enforced limits rely on so-called reference prices, these are computed every day for each resource at each quality. A volume-weighted average price (VWAP) of the previous day, is used to compute the reference price. The reference price might be considered unreliable if there was low trading activity.

In the absence of a reliable reference price, company sourcing cost and the current market price can be used. Furthermore, the Contest resource and Government Orders, or their inputs; have the limits relaxed a bit to allow speculation.

The exact logic of limit checks is very complex to describe and subject to change, so there is little point in documenting it. It is a result of multiple iterations.

REPORTING AN ISSUE

If you feel like the limits are preventing you to do an action that makes total business sense, something is wrong and you should submit a bug. Please specify:

  • the time

  • what are you trying to sell

  • what quality

  • what price

  • what is your sourcing cost

  • current market price

We can then evaluate if the limit is indeed functioning as intended and do changes to allow such operation in the future.

We have good experience and track record with the current limits system, unless of course there are special conditions, like launching of a new industry.

Note: The reference prices are also used for valuation allowance computation.

zh-cn.title: 参考价格和市场限价
zh-cn.body:
由SweetPotato翻译并维护（维护-第一版）

玩家发布市场订单和合同的价格是有限制的。这有多种原因：

  • “胖手指”检查——一个明智的游戏不应该让你在不经意间以荒谬的低价或高价发布你的产品。这些限制被称为“胖手指”检查（一个人可能会意外地按到其他键盘上的按键）

  • 防止欺诈——我们希望避免在“友好”的公司之间轻易转移现金。这可以通过以荒谬的价格销售和/或购买产品来实现。虽然我们有其他机制来检测这一点：公平竞争协会  最好还是先避免。

实现这一目标并非易事，因为我们的经济经常变动，资源价格也不稳定。由于经济变化、竞争、政府订单和市场操纵，我们会出现波动。这些限制不会妨碍公司正常运营。

目前强制执行的限制依赖于所谓的参考价格，这些价格是每天针对每个质量（Q）的每种资源计算的。前一天的成交量加平均价格（VWAP）用于计算参考价格。如果交易活动较少，则参考价格可能被视为不可靠。

在缺乏可靠参考价格的情况下，可以使用公司采购成本和当前市场价格。此外，竞赛资源和政府订单，或其输入将会放宽限制，允许投机。

限制检查的确切逻辑非常复杂，难以描述，并且可能会发生变化，因此几乎没有记录它的意义。这是多次迭代的结果。

反馈问题

如果你觉得这些限制阻碍了你做一件完全有商业意义的事情，那就是出了问题，你应该提交bug反馈。请具体说明：

  • 时间

  • 你想买什么

  • 什么品质（Q）

  • 什么价格

  • 你的（采购/制造）成本是多少

  • 当前市价

然后，我们可以评估是否真的发生了错误，并进行更改，以允许将来进行此类操作。

我们在现行限额方面有着良好的经验和记录，当然，除非有特殊情况，比如出现一个新行业等。

注：参考价格也用于估值备抵计算。

en.title: Research guide
en.body:
RESEARCH

Investing in research allows companies to produce higher quality products. High quality products are sold faster in retail allowing higher profit.

You may have noticed "stars" next to the products on the market. These determine the quality level of the resource. By default, you can manufacture quality 0 (Q0), by investing into research, you can get manufacture capability up to higher levels.

In order to do research you will need to be level 10.

RESEARCH UNITS AND PATENTS

To invest in research you need to get so called research units. Depending on the industry you want to get higher quality level in, you need to get the right research units. Go to the RESEARCH screen to see what research units are needed for which products. You can obtain research units either by getting a laboratory building, or buying them from other players. Note: production of aerospace research works a little differently than other research. You can find more info in the Aerospace industry guide.

Your research progress for your products can be found in the Warehouse.

The research is divided into each research type: Plant, Energy, Mining, Electronics, Breeding, Chemistry, Software, Automotive, Fashion, Aerospace, Materials and Recipes.

The above image shows the products that fall under Materials Research. The number in the (0) is how many research units you have of that research type. Any product that shows yellow stars is how much quality you have researched per product. The above image shows Q3 for Carbon Composite and Q2 for heat Shield. The rest of the products that do not have stars are Q0. There are progress bars at the bottom of each product that show you how far along that product is until the next quality is reached.

Going into Tools you can see the following screen:

To get to quality 1 in Tools; you need 12 patents. (0 patents out of 12)

You can enter how many research units to use to do research in the text box. Then press “Apply Research.”
If, you don’t have research for that specific research unit you can use the blue link at the bottom to take you to the exchange for that research. In the example above you can see the current research price on the exchange is $248.

Once you’ve obtained research units, you can try to get your research patented by using them in the RESEARCH screen. You can imagine rolling a dice for each research point, getting a patent each time you get a six.


You will need 12 patents to get quality level 1 (Q1), another 50 for quality level 2 (Q2), 500 more for quality level 3 (Q3) and finally 2000 more for quality level 4 (Q4).

PRODUCTION OF HIGH QUALITY PRODUCTS

Do I just need to invest in Q1 smart phones research and I can produce Q1 smart phones? Yes, that's exactly right, once your company is granted the 12 patents needed, all the smart phones you produce from then onwards will be Q1. There's no need to decide what quality you want to produce, the highest quality possible is always produced.

Does the same work for Q2? Not entirely. You do need to invest research to achieve Q2, but you also need all your input resources to be at least Q1. The rule is simple: The manufactured product cannot be higher quality than the lowest quality input resource plus one.

Let's say you want to sell petrol Q3 and you already invested in the research. You will need crude oil that's at least Q2, ethanol that’s at least Q2 and power that's also Q2 minimum.

(Not pictured; To produce Q2 crude oil, you will need at least Q1 power. To produce Q2 ethanol, you will need Q1 sugarcane and Q1 power.)

Some players wonder what's higher quality water for? It can't be sold in retail, so why bother leveling the quality up. Well, it's simple, you need high quality water, to produce high quality apples, oranges, etc.


Another Example:

To make Q3 fabric you will need Q2+ cotton and Q2+ power. To make Q2 Cotton you will need Q1+ water and Q1+ seeds. To make Q1 water you will need Q0+ power.

HOW EXACTLY DOES QUALITY IMPACT RETAIL

As mentioned at the beginning, higher quality products are sold faster in retail. The higher the demand the higher the quality impact.

To learn more about how product selling speed impacts your hourly profit check out:

https://www.simcompanies.com/pages/economy-model/

Let’s take a look at retailing apples of varying quality. We assume fixed apple sourcing cost at $2.40

Conclusion: you want to be selling high quality products that are in demand. (Yes, surprising …)

RETURN ON INVESTMENT

We covered the mechanics, so let's answer the most obvious questions. Should I invest in research, and when should I do so.

In principle, you can use your funds to either get more plants and shops, or to increase the quality of the products you are selling. While you are very small, it's almost always better to do the former, get more buildings, or level up the buildings. However, having more employees increases your labor cost and you will start getting diminishing results. Investing in research on the other hand will allow you to earn more per each unit you sell, while keeping your employee headcount the same.

HAVING A GOOD CTO

Cost of getting a good Chief Technical Officer (CTO) can vary greatly. A young student fresh of the university will have skill 0 - 3. Training him/her, or keeping the executive around for long time can cost anywhere around $50k to $200k. See executives guide.

CTO affects the following:

  • All research labs (buildings producing research units) will gain a +2% production speed boost per point of science skill in your executive team.
  • Rocket launches will yield +2% more research points per science skill point.

Read more about the CTO impact from Patrik's article: CTOs demand more than just a Final Act

The default Patent Probability is 6.25% which equals sixteen (16) research per one (1) patent on average.   (100/6.25% = 16 research)  
To get to Quality 1 (Q1) looking at the chart above; we need twelve (12) patents.  A 6.25% patent probability requires 192 research to get to Q1 on average.  A CTO increases your Patent Probability.  


Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:
Genie of the Lamp: The Power of Science

ACHIEVEMENTS

There are achievements that can be earned by researching products.

  • Scientist

  • Know-it-all

SUMMARY

It makes sense to invest in research once your company gets larger (reaches about $1,300,000 in company value or 3,000 employees). The larger your company, the more sense high quality products make. Having a strong CTO on retainer is worth if you are getting Q3 research or higher.

by Patrik Beck

Special Thanks: The Traveller, for confirming Aerospace Research patent value after the November 2020, Aerospace Nerf.

zh-cn.title: 研究指南
zh-cn.body:
由The Center & 老K维护

该指南已过时，研究系统已更新，我们正在准备新版本。

研究

通过投资研究点数，公司可以生产更高品质的产品。品质等级高的产品可以在零售端以更快速度、更高价格出售。你或许已经注意到，产品图标上方的星星。星星的数量代表了产品的品质等级。默认设置下，你的产品等级都是0星品质（Q0）。通过投入研究点数，你可以提升自身产出的产品品质。产品研究与品质将在10级解锁。

研究点数和专利

投入研究的“产品”被称为“研究点数”。每个产品都需要特定类型的研究点数，但是产品所需的研究类型是不严格地对应于所属行业的。你可以在“仓库-研究”面板查看产品对应的研究点数的类型。研究点数可以通过实验室/研究所建筑获取，也可以从其他玩家处交易获得。

“仓库-研究”面板中也同时记录了你公司产品的当前研究进度。

研究点数有以下类型：农作物、能源、采矿、电器、畜牧、化学、软件、汽车、时装、航空航天、材料、食谱。

上图表记了材料研究下辖的各产品。括号中的数字（0）表示了你的当前库存中，研究点数的数量（为0）。产品下方的黄色星星表示了你已完成研究的产品等级。例如，图中的碳纤混合材（Carbon Composites）的品质等级是3星（Q3），而隔热板（Heat Shield）的品质等级是2星（Q2）。其余产品没有显示星星，因此都是0星（Q0）产品。产品图标最下部的进度条表示了下一级产品品质的研究进度。

点击工具（Tools）这个产品，你将看到如下面板：

要完成3星品质的研究，你需要将研究点数转化为500项专利（需要500项专利，已完成1项）。

中间输入框中的数字是你想投入的研究点数数量。输入数字，然后点击“应用研究”，就可将研究点数转化为专利。如果需要到交易所购买更多的研究点数，可以直接点击下方的蓝色链接。图中可以看到，在截图的时候，材料研究的市价是$222。

以上就是将研究点数转化为专利的操作。大体上，每投入12个研究单位可以转化为1项专利。你可以将这个过程想象为系统为每个研究单位掷了一次八面骰，每当骰子掷出“1”时，系统为你的公司发放1个专利。

1星产品（Q1）需要12项专利；2星产品（Q2）需要50项专利；3星产品（Q3）需要500项专利；4星产品（Q4）需要2000项专利。

生产高品质产品

要生产1星智能手机，是否只要投资于12项专利，解锁1星智能手机研究即可？没错，就是这样。当12项智能手机的专利完成后，所有你公司生产的智能手机默认成为1星品质。系统会自动为你选定当前能够生产的最高品质产品。

2星品质的操作是否完全相同？不完全如此。除了需要解锁2星研究外，你还需要生产该产品所需的所有原料的品质为1星或以上。规则简单来说就是：【产品品质】不能高于【原料品质+1】（多种原料品质不同时，取决于品质最低的原料）。

下面是一个简单的例子。比方说我们要生产3星汽油，并且已经解锁了相关研究。那么，就必须在库存中准备好2星或以上的原油、2星或以上的乙醇、2星或以上的电力，并确保它们不在【禁用】状态。

（图片只展示了汽油的生产；而2星原油要从1星电力转化而来；2星乙醇则需要从1星甘蔗和1星电力转化而来）

有些玩家或许对“高品质工业用水”的概念疑惑不解——它们是干什么用的？反正零售用不到这些产品，为什么还要花功夫去研究？答案是，高品质水可以用于生产高品质苹果、橘子等零售产品。


下面是另外一个例子：

要生产3星棉布，你将需要2星（或以上）的棉花和2星（或以上）的电力。而要生产2星棉花，你将需要1星（或以上）水和1星（或以上）种子。要生产1星水，则需要0星（或以上）电力。

投资回报率

上面介绍了基本机制。下面我们看一下研究规划的问题：是否应该投资于某项研究，以及何时进行此项投资。

大体上，现金既可以用于建造工厂和商店，也可以用于提升产品品质。当你的公司规模尚小时，建筑投资（建造新的工厂/商店建筑）总是优于产品品质投资。然而，当你的公司规模扩大，员工人数增加，相关的人员成本和管理费用会逐渐侵蚀新建筑/更高级别建筑的收益。产品品质投资则与之不同：投资收益体现为你可以在更高价格出售产品，通过积累出货量逐渐获取回报，而不会增加你的员工数量。

下面是一个实际例子。要将苹果提升至1星品质大约需要 12 × 8 = 96 个作物研究点数。假设研究点数的成本是每单位$150，那么总投资就是$14,400——当然，市场价一般低于每单位$150。如果你自己生产作物研究点数，其成本可以降至每单位$90，那么加总后的1星品质苹果需要的投资就只需$8,640。

假设经济周期为【正常】，在相同零售速度和销售时间下，你可以在零售商店中将每个苹果的售价提升$0.1383。因此，要回收投资的$14,400，你将需要零售大约104,121个苹果；另一方面，如果你的初期投资是$6,480，那么你只需要零售46,854个苹果。

我们再来估算收回投资所需的时间成本。其实，所需的时间将取决于经济周期和你的零售策略。假设你有2间5级生鲜商店，他们能以350个/小时的速度零售苹果，那么，你将需要7天收回$14,400的初始投资（若从市场获取研究点数），或者3天收回$8,640的初始投资（若自行生产研究点数）。

首席科研官（CTO）的影响

好的首席科研官（CTO）的成本可能有巨大差异。初出茅庐的应届生可能只有0-3点【科学能力】。但通过培训，或长时间的首席科研官（CTO）经验，可以将其【科学能力】显著提升。这样做的成本大约在$50,000到$200,000的范围内。详情参见高管指南。

默认专利概率为 6.25%，平均每获得一项专利需要 16 项研究。（100/6.25% = 16 项研究）根据上图，要达到质量 1 (Q1) 级，我们需要 12 项专利。6.25% 的专利概率平均需要 192 项研究才能达到 Q1 级。首席技术官 (CTO) 可以提高您的专利概率。

欲知更多，可以参见《SC时报》的以下文章：
[英文] Genie of the Lamp: The Power of Science

成就

通过研究，可以解锁以下成就：

  • 科学家

  • 万事通

总结

当你的公司规模逐渐扩大（公司价值约 $1,300,000 或员工人数3,000）时，投资于产品品
质的研究会是一个优秀的策略。公司规模越大，越应该提升产品品质。首席科研官
（CTO）可以节约初期投资，但是考虑到员工工资和培训投入，应该在研究3星品质或以上
时雇佣首席科研官（CTO），才会比较划算。

作者：Patrik Beck

鸣谢：The Traveller，其在2020年11月航空航天削弱后确认了航空航天研究的专利价值。

en.title: Restaurant guide
en.body:
The Sim Companies food expansion brought a lot of new food industry resources and buildings, but also a completely new way of doing retail!

Are you considering running a successful restaurant business? There are few things you should know.

As a restaurant owner, your goal is to run your restaurant in a profitable way. You are responsible for deciding:

  • what is on the menu - which food items and at what quality.

  • what’s the quality of your staff.

  • is your restaurant spacious, luxurious, or throughput-oriented?

All of the decisions above influence your costs and the rating of your restaurant. The restaurant rating needs to be built over time.

Your CMO (communication) also impacts the rating your restaurant receives. Effective communication skill points increases your restaurant rating by 0.01

The most important aspect the restaurant owner needs to decide on is the price of the menu. You can think of this as the price of one meal, or the price each of your customers will pay.

Whether the virtual population of Sim Companies, Simeons, decides to dine at your restaurant is driven by the price and the rating of your restaurant. They take into account your price/rating offer, as well as the other restaurants in the game, and decide where they want to dine.

While setting the price, you will see a red/green bar showing you revenue estimates at various levels of occupation. The higher the price, the larger the maximum possible revenue, the lower the price the higher chances your restaurant will be cheaper than the competition and thus get a high occupancy.

The restaurant operates in 12 hours cycles. Before the cycle is started, you can make adjustments and update your menu price. At this time, your costs (wages and food sourcing costs) are known.

The restaurant occupancy and updated rating are known only at the end of the cycle. Since revenue depends on occupancy, revenue and profit are only known after the cycle is over.

The restaurant can be set up to automatically start a new cycle after one finishes - automatically deducting food items from your warehouse.

Warning: by pressing the “open for business” button you are going to start the 12 hour cycle for the restaurant. This cannot be cancelled.

The “close restaurant” button that appears is so you can stop the next 12 hour cycle from automatically starting.

Note: Rating will decrease when the restaurant is closed (12.5% reduction occurs only once on closure).

The “keep open” button allows you to queue the next 12 hour cycle automatically.

RESTAURANT MENU - FOOD ITEMS

At least one item in each food category is required. Each food item has a different impact on your new rating, depending mostly on their cost. You also receive a rating bonus for having a variety of items. The more items in a category are available, the less of each is consumed.

Higher quality food impacts your new rating as well.

Warning: Food items available on the menu during a cycle are lost whether they are sold to Simeons or not. The leftover food simply goes to waste (spoiled).

The top number shown on each item is how many units you have your in your Warehouse. The bottom number is showing how many units will be needed/used during the 12 hour cycle of the restaurant. Having more than one item selected in each category changes the amount needed for each cycle.

You can either set the sell low quality or high quality foods from your inventory. Quality is consumed based on the setting of Low or High.

Low quality starts at q0 and goes upwards to q1 then q2 and so on.

High quality starts at q12 then goes downwards to q11 and so on.

You may have multiple restaurants at different tiers (fast food or fancy); a fast food restaurant with low quality selected, will only pull the lowest possible quality items from your warehouse to sell during the cycle. While your fancy restaurant may want to sell high quality food and this will pull the highest possible quality foods from your warehouse.

If the item is not in your warehouse the Exchange button will appear at the bottom.

RESTAURANT OCCUPANCY

The virtual people of Sim Companies are split into 3 groups:

  • High paying customers, looking mainly at rating and less on the price;

  • Customers on budget, looking primarily at the menu price;

  • Middle-class customers, looking at both.

The proportional size of each group changes with the economic cycle. The goal is to position your restaurant offer where the demand is and competition is lacking. It could be low costs, high throughput, cheap restaurants. Or low throughput, high rating, upscale expensive dining place.

Furthermore, the size of all 3 groups is influenced by the number of buildings of active players in the game. So, the restaurant demand and occupancy are high if there are comparatively few restaurants in the game. But it can easily turn around if all companies decide to build restaurants.

STAFF QUALITY

You can decide to hire professional staff to replace rookies. The professional staff results in a higher rating but also makes your wages 5 times higher. Changing the staff type doesn't require downtime.

SEATING STYLE

You can decide between fast-food style (throughput-optimized seating) and luxury style. Fast-food (Economy) style has more seating capacity but is not very luxurious. Or you can have a fancy, upscale place with fewer tables, which gets a higher rating. There are no operating costs for the fancy decorations, but the renovation requires downtime equal to upgrade time and costs similarly.

Having fewer tables reduces your maximum revenue since it will result in fewer paying customers even at maximum occupancy. However, this also reduces your food requirements proportionally: lower COGS.

Luxury restaurant wages are half of the economy restaurant wages.

Level one restaurant:
1000 seats for Economy and 500 seats for Luxury

Increasing the level of the restaurant increases capacity:

LEVEL

SEATS (ECONOMY)

SEATS (LUXURY)

1

1000

500

2

2000

1000

3

3000

1500

4

4000

2000

And so on…

 

 

CONCLUSION

Do you have the chops to make it in Restaurant retail?

RECAP

In order to open the restaurant for business:

Need to pick at least 1 item from each category (salad bar, main courses, drinks) in the menu.

Need to input a Menu price.

Optional items are Restaurant Seating and Staff Options.

Menu Price max value is $350, lowest value is $60

Other Details:

Once open for business each retail cycle is 12 hours. Note: once you start the cycle it cannot be cancelled.

Each restaurant has its own rating.

Closing the restaurant decreases rating by 12.5% (occurs only once when restaurant closes).

Effective communication skill points increases your restaurant rating by 0.01.

Sales speed bonus adds 0.02 to the resulting restaurant rating. 

Luxury restaurant multiplies the effect of the rating, rather than add to it.

ARTICLES

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:

Demystifying Restaurants - Part 1
Demystifying Restaurants - Part 2
Demystifying Restaurants - Part 3

(Note: Part 1, 2, and 3, were published before 21st of February, 2022 - Changes to restaurants )

What is needed to successfully run a restaurant?

By Patrik Beck

zh-cn.title: 餐馆指南
zh-cn.body:
由Silverman AG/ 中文区协管进行翻译

食品工业的扩张包含了许多新产品和建筑，但也包含了一个全新的零售方式！

你在考虑经营一家成功的餐馆吗？这里有几件你在开始之前应该知道的事情。

你的主要目标是以盈利的方式经营你的餐厅。你必须决定几个因素：

  • 菜单 - 哪些菜，菜的品质

  • 人员的素质

  • 餐馆的风格 - 豪华，宽敞，或经济？

所有的决定会影响你的成本和餐馆的评级。你得慢慢建立你的餐馆的声誉和评级。

你的CMO也会影响你的餐馆获得的评级。每一个CMO沟通点会使你的餐馆评级增加0.01。

你必须决定的最重要方面是菜单的价格。你可以把它看作是一顿饭的价格，或者是你的每个客户将支付的价格。

餐馆的受欢迎程度是由餐馆的评级和菜单价格决定的。Sim Companies的虚拟“人口”（Sim人）考虑到这两个因素，并查看游戏中的其他餐厅，以决定在哪家餐厅吃饭。

在设置价格时，屏幕上会显示一个彩色条，显示不同占用率下的收入估计。较高的菜单价格会增加最大可能的收入，但较低的菜单价格会增加占用率。

餐馆以 12 小时的周期运行。在周期开始之前，你可以进行调整并更新菜单价格。此时，你的成本（工资和食物采购成本）是已知的。

餐馆的占用率和更新后的评级只有在周期结束后才能知道。由于收入取决于占用率，收入和利润只有在周期结束后才能得知。

餐馆可以设置为在一个周期结束后自动开始新周期——自动从你的仓库中扣除食物。

警告： 按下"开门营业"按钮后，餐馆将开始一个 12 小时的周期。此操作无法取消。

出现的"关闭餐馆"按钮是为了防止下一个 12 小时周期自动开始。

注意： 关闭餐馆时评级会下降（12.5% 的降幅仅在关闭时发生一次）。

"保持营业" 按钮可以让你自动排入下一个 12 小时周期。

餐馆菜单

每种食物类别中至少要有一道菜。每道菜对你的评级有不同的影响，主要取决于其成本。如果你提供各种菜，你也会得到一个评级奖励。一个类别的菜越多，每种菜的消耗量就越少。

菜的品质也会影响你的评级。

警告： 周期内菜单上的食物无论是否出售给 Sim 人都将被消耗。剩余的食物会直接浪费（变质）。

每道菜上部的数字代表仓库里的数量。下部的数字代表一个周期所需的数量。这个数字取决于有多少道菜被选中。

你可以选择从仓库中出售低品质或高品质的食物。品质消耗基于"低"或"高"的设置。

设置为"低品质"时，从 q0 开始，往上到 q1、q2，以此类推。

设置为"高品质"时，从 q12 开始，往下到 q11、q10，以此类推。

你可以拥有多个不同档次的餐馆（快餐式或高档餐厅）：一家设置为低品质的快餐店，在周期中只会从你的仓库中取出品质最低的食物进行出售；而你的高档餐厅如果想出售高品质食物，则会从仓库中取出品质最高的食物。

如果你仓库里没有那道菜，就会显示一个通往交易所的链接。

餐馆占用率

有三种Sim人：

  • 富裕的客户：他们更关心评级而不是价格

  • 不太富裕的客户：主要考虑价格

  • 中产阶级客户：两者同等考虑

每个群体的比例大小取决于经济周期。你的目标是吸引最多的Sim人，避免竞争。这种策略有可能是低价格和高座位量，也有可能是高价格和豪华风格。

此外，群体的大小受到游戏中活跃玩家的建筑数量的影响，因为每个建筑级有100名工人。因此，如果游戏中的餐馆相对比较少，餐馆的需求和占用率就会很高。然而，如果有许多餐馆，需求和占用率就会降低。

员工素质

你可以聘请专业餐馆人员来代替培训生。专业人员会带来更高的评级，但也会使你的工资提高5倍。改变员工类型不需要停机。

风格

你可以选择快餐式，或豪华式。快餐式有更多的座位，但不是很豪华。豪华风格的座位数较少，但会带来更高的评级。花哨的装饰没有维护成本，但装修需要的停工时间与升级时间相等，成本也差不多。

提升餐馆等级可以增加客容量：

等级 座位（经济型） 座位（豪华型）
1 1000 500
2 2000 1000
3 3000 1500
4 4000 2000

座位减少会降低你的最大收入，因为即使在最高占用率的情况下，你的客户数也不会很高。然而，这也按比例减少了你的食品需求，意味着成本降低。
注意： 豪华餐馆工资是快餐的二分之一。

总结

开店之前：

  • 菜单上的每一种食品类型必须有至少一道菜（萨拉吧、主菜和饮料）。

  • 你必须设定菜单价格。

  • 你可以调整员工和风格。

  • 菜单的价钱是从60（最低）～350（最高）

额外信息：

  • 每个零售周期持续12小时

  • 每家餐馆有自己的评级

  • 当餐馆停止营业时，该餐馆的评级将会降低12.5%

  • CMO的能力指数将会增加餐馆评级+0.01

  • 零售速度加成会增加餐馆评价+0.02

  • 豪华餐馆的评级效果是倍增式模式

文库指南/文章:

Demystifying Restaurants - Part 1
Demystifying Restaurants - Part 2
Demystifying Restaurants - Part 3

Optimizing Restaurant Success: Key Decisions

(Note: Part 1, 2, and 3, were published before 21st of February - Changes to restaurants ) by Patrik Beck

en.title: Robotics & specialization
en.body:
Welcome to the new age of Robots!

OVERVIEW

Robots are a game feature that allows players to improve manufacturing costs.

RESOURCES

The resource is Robots!


BUILDING

Electronics Factory

RESOURCES

Resources needed in order to produce robots.

Electric motor, Processors, Plastic

RESEARCH

Software is required in order to increase the quality of Robots!

MECHANICS

Can apply robots to any production building (except for research buildings). Robots cannot be retailed.

The cost of robots is based on the building cost and level of buildings. The Encyclopedia for each building has a list of the required amount for robots and quality needed shown under Construction Times.

Building Levels:

1-3

Q0 (or higher Q) robots

4-7

Q1 (or higher Q) robots

8-11

Q2 (or higher Q) robots

12-15

Q3 (or higher Q) robots

16-19

Q4 (or higher Q) robots

20-23

Q5 (or higher Q) robots

(…and so on)

Reminder: quantity of robots required is different for each building; visit the encyclopedia for each building type.

INSTALLING ROBOTS

Installing robots to a building will limit that building to produce just ONE (1) product. The base worker wages will go down by 3%. Note: this reduction impacts the value used to computing admin costs.

Downtime will be required in order to install robots. Rushing is possible with Sim Boosts. It is not possible to upgrade a building while Robots are installed.  The downtime for installing robots is the time required to upgrade the next level of the same type of building (x+1).

Note: In order to upgrade any building with robots installed; they will need to uninstalled from that building.

Helpful articles from our local newspaper The Sim Companies Times:

Should I install robots? (Part 1 & 2)

Should I install robots? (Part 3)

When installing robots, obtaining any of the required materials; will pull them from your warehouse stock. While, any missing materials can be purchased from the Exchange using the BUY MISSING button.

Selecting the product specialization will allow you to install the robots. Reminder: you will only be allowed to produce that product in that building after robots are installed.

UNINSTALLING ROBOTS

Uninstalling robots comes at a cost: 50% of the robots will be returned and will be quality zero (Q0).

NOTES

Company Value: Installing robots is not reflected in the company value. The Income Statement will show “loss” in the “Construction costs.”

Q0 robots: will, over time, become very cheap. Large companies will not need Q0 for high level buildings. This will allow new companies to be able to purchase the robots from the market and experiment at low cost.

SUMMARY

Robots are a powerful tool, they can reduce your production costs but they will restrict your flexibility. How will you strike the perfect balance?

Library Guides:

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ), Guide for Beginners, Research Guide, Executives Guide,
Government Orders Guide, Aerospace Guide

By The Center

zh-cn.title: 机器人技术和专业
zh-cn.body:
由The Center维护 / 由Silverman AG翻译

欢迎来到机器人的新时代！

概述

机器人技术是一个有助于降低制造成本的游戏特征。

新产品

新带来的产品是机器人！

建筑

机器人可以在电子产品厂中生产。

物资

生产机器人所需的物资：

电动马达，处理器，塑料

研究

软件是用来研究机器人的。

机器人机制

除了研究建筑以外，你可以在任何生产建筑中安装机器人。有无法零售机器人。

安装机器人技术所需的机器人数量是根据每种建筑的参考价值和建筑等级确定的。每种建筑的百科条目里有需要的机器人数量和品质。

例子：电子产品厂的机器人安装信息（请注意，每种建筑有所不同，请参见百科）。

建筑等级

1-3级：至少Q0机器人
4-7级：至少Q1机器人
8-11级：至少Q2机器人
12-15级：至少Q3机器人
16-19级：至少Q4机器人
20-23级：至少Q5机器人
（等等……）

安装机器人

安装机器人将限制你在安装机器人的建筑只生产一种产品。基本工人工资将减少3%。请注意：这也将影响管理费的计算。

安装机器人花时间（跟升级建筑花的时间一样）。你可以花simboosts来快速完成机器人安装。无法在机器人安装或运行时升级或降级此建筑。

请注意：如果你想要升级一座有机器人的建筑，你得先移除机器人。

安装时，所需的机器人会自动从你的仓库存货中拿去安装。点击购买缺少材料按钮将从交易所上购买任何缺少的机器人。

选择你想要的产品专修将让你进行机器人安装。请注意：安装后，你只能生产你选的那一种产品。

移除机器人

移除机器人时，你将只能恢复安装过的机器人的一半（以品质0 ）。

回顾

公司价值（CV）：已安装的机器人不计入公司价值。

Q0机器人：过一会儿，品质0机器人会变得很便宜。对比较大的公司来说，Q0机器人没用，但移除机器人技术将恢复Q0机器人。因此，比较小的公司将能够便宜地购买机器人，并以比较低的成本做试用。

机器人是一个强大的工具，它们可以减少你的生产成本，但它们会限制你的灵活性。你将如何取得完美的平衡？

常见问题，新人指南，研究指南，建筑业指南，债券指南，高管指南，政府订单指南，航空航天业指南

en.title: Guide for supporters
en.body:
Guide for supporters

Hello and thanks for supporting or wanting to support the game!

The supporter package is intentionally designed to not be “Pay 2 Win.” The main focus of Supporter is to help the developer, Patrik, keep the lights on. Supporters do not get any special advantage compared regular players!

The advantages / features in an overview:

Collect All

By pressing on the collect all button in the lower right; all resources and cash that is floating above the buildings can be collected.

Building linking

Linking buildings allows companies to run multiple buildings of the same type and product at the same time. Example: if you want to start the production of power in several power plants, you no longer have to start each power plant separately, but can do this from a single power plant.

  • Pick a building that you want to use as a “Control” building.

  • Click on "Control"

  • Select from the list which buildings that this “Control” building will lead.

Note: It might make sense to rename buildings.

In the GIF above; Power plant 1 was selected as “Control” of Power Plants 2 thru 6.

In the GIF below; you can see that Power Plant 1, Controls all the power plants on this map when starting production of Power.

If one of the linked buildings has a lower level than the main Control building, the production quantity is adjusted, but the buildings run at the same time.

  • If you do not have enough resources, linked buildings will not start.

  • If you do not have enough resources of the necessary quality the game will notify you with a box at the top of the map indicating the resource missing.

Supporter-Chatroom

You will get access to the Supporter Chatroom (English).

Here, Patrik is relatively active and asks for opinions.

Also, problems with new features are discussed, which supporters test first.

Supporters have the ability to insert images and gifs to supporter chat.

Adding Images:

There are two ways to add images:
1) Post images from your device by dragging and dropping them into chat.  You will need to have access to your local file and simply drag the image from your local file into the area at the bottom of chat to insert the image.

2) By using the following code to link any outside sourced image/gif.   [[IMG:insert-link]]   This has to be exactly as shown.  IMG has to be capital and no spaces between the colon and the link.   If you are are posting a .png or .jpg or .gif; these need to be included on the link.

Example:

[[IMG:https://i.imgur.com/bLkEMrr.png]]

3) By getting the URL link that has the ".gif" a the end.  Can post directly to chat without using the code above. 
There are a number of GIF sites you can chose from:  giphy, tenor, etc. 

Permanent 10% discount on Sim Boosts purchases

As a Supporter you receive a permanent and automatic 10% discount on all Sim Boosts purchases, if there is an additional sale you save even more!

If you bought Sim Boosts 2 hours before a Sale this will be credited to your account.

Early access to new features

If Patrik is working on something, that is actually or almost finished, as a supporter you get the new features first. 

You can help to test the new features, identify minor bugs so that they can be fixed before the new feature is released to everyone.

As you can see, you won't be able to buy any decisive advantages with the supporter package.

This is intended. We do not want Pay 2 Win.

As a supporter you can prove your dedication to the game and help Patrik with the further development of the game!

zh-cn.title: 支持者指南
zh-cn.body:
由The Center & Silverman AG维护 / 由Powerverse翻译

大家好，谢谢大家任何直接的，间接的支持！

推出支持者套餐的本意并不是让玩家们能够以simboosts的方式来“赢得游戏”，而是支持Patrik，我们的游戏开发者，以便他可以提高完善进度。支持者们是没有任何特殊优势的，所有玩家都会享有同样的游戏体验。

 

支持者享有的福利如下：

收集全部

通过按下右下角的“收集所有”按钮；漂浮在建筑物上方的所有资源和现金都会被收集。

 

建筑链接

已链接的建筑物将让玩家们可以同时操控多个同类型建筑物。列如：支持者们有超过两个以上的发电厂，那么玩家只需要一个发电厂来开始所有的发电厂生产，不需要逐个发电厂去开始生产。

  • 挑选一个你想要设定为“主”操控的建筑物。

  • 点击“控制”。

  • 在控制列表里选择想要被操控的“副”建筑物。

注意： 为了大致了解地图上的建筑，建议玩家们更换建筑名。请参详以下“建筑”部分的解说。

上图显示，推进器工厂1 已选择为推进器工厂2和3的“主”建筑。

下图显示，当推进器工厂1生产电动马达时，所有已控制的推进器工厂将跟随推进器工厂1进行生产。

当“副”建筑出现比“主”建筑低等级时，出产量将会调整，但所有的建筑物将会以同样的时间结束生产。

  • 如果玩家没有足够的的资源，已操控的“副”建筑将不会开始生产。

  • 如果玩家没有足够对应质量的资源，已操控的“副”建筑也将不会开始生产，玩家也会得到来自个人助理（PA）的提醒。

支持者聊天室

 

玩家将得到支持者聊天室的使用权（英文）。

在这里，Patrik会相对的活跃和询问玩家的意见。

除此之外，新功能所会衍生的问题将在这，支持者聊天室进行讨论，支持者也将享有权利，使用任何新推出的功能。

发图片

有两种方法：

  1. 通过从你的设备上把图片拖放到聊天框（写着“在此输入……”的地方）来发图片。

2. 使用以下格式来链接任何外部来源的图片/gif：[[IMG:link]] 这必须完全如图所示。“IMG”必须是大写的，没有空格。 一般来说，链接应该以.png、.jpg或.gif结尾。

例如：

[[IMG:https://i.imgur.com/bLkEMrr.png]]

10%终身Simboosts优惠

作为一位支持者，你将自动拥有10%Simboosts优惠，优惠活动期间你也将会剩下更多。

抢先体验-新功能

支持者将享有比非支出者较早的权力，抢先体验Patrik接近完成或已完成的新功能。

你可以帮他尝试新功能，发现关于新功能的问题。这让Patrik在新功能发布之前修复。

除了以上所述 ，支持者将不会得到任何特殊优势。

这是有意而为之！！我们不需要“氪金游戏”的游戏体验。

身为一个支持者，我们能做的就是证明我们对游戏的热衷和帮助开发者，Patrik来完善整个游戏！

en.title: Moderator's Guide
en.body:
MODERATORS

The primary job as a Moderator is to monitor the chat rooms, looking for meaningful discussions that we can engage in, and help players that have questions, suggestions or concerns. The most important job as a Moderator is to make sure our players are not only following our Terms and Conditions but having the best time possible!

When a mod pulls up a player's profile, they will see this under their company name:

BANNING ABILITY

Moderators can decide whether the player should be given a warning, or for extreme cases apply a chat ban right away.

Chat bans are temporary bans that are removing the ability for players to use chat rooms.

In most cases a resolution can be found before we have to ban a player. Many "offenses" are just players testing out boundaries and if called upon it they stop.

To allow fair and cooperative bans, the system automatically determines the ban length based on the number of previous offenses. Repeat offenders are getting ever increasing ban lengths:
The progressive system starting at 2 hours; and follows this pattern: 2, 2, 8, 16, 32, 64, and so on.

System also automatically determines when to ban the whole IP and refuse new registrations based on multiple bans given to players on the same IP. The goal is to stop offenders that create a 2nd account right away to circumvent a ban.

There are a few more tricks up in our sleeves for difficult cases that are not made public. These are applied when we no longer feel the player's offensive behavior can be altered and are just trying to block him/her from using chats altogether.

COMPANY IDENTITY IN VIOLATION OF T&C

Moderators can decide whether the player should be given a warning, or for extreme cases the identity cleared right away. If warning is selected, the user gets a PA message that is asking the offender to update their profile info. Personal Assistant will also remind the MOD chat after some time, so MODs can check if user complied. Here again, the system determines when to send warning and when to ban, based on history of offenses. Low level offending companies can be deleted right away.

MODERATORS CHAT ROOM

Moderators have access to both the Moderators Chat Room and the Supporters Chat Room.

In the Moderators Chat Room we discuss the offenders, what ban should be applied and whether the player was warned already. We also discuss whether the logo or company description is over the line in regards to Terms and Conditions. The pressing technical issues are also brought forward. Moderators also have access to the Supporters Chat Room (this is a courtesy that Patrik has granted them). New ideas, upcoming projects, and opinions on many things that Patrik asks us about are discussed in the Supporters chat.

Moderators have the ability to see other player's hash IP addresses. This is a handy tool, especially when dealing with schools that utilize our game. They do NOT to share this information with anyone else! Player privacy is very important to us!

MODERATORS ARE APPOINTED

There is no application process to be a moderator. Moderators are selected after being nominated as a candidate and discussed in Mod chat.

The following list is not a checklist that once passed you become a moderator. There are many experienced players that are helpful to the community that are not moderating. When we consider expanding the moderating team we discuss possible candidates in the MODs channel. We try to find candidates that:

  • Are active players and understand the game - this is easy to see when helpful replies are posted in the Help chat room

  • Have great relationship with existing moderators

  • When audited, there's no record of prior cheating having multiple accounts - we are more strict here than Fair Play Association

  • Are level-headed and with stone skin ;)

  • Have contributed a good article to Sim Companies times

  • We tend to prefer more veteran players

  • Speaking more languages is a big plus

Note: Writing to me, Patrik, directly doesn't help. As in many cases I simply ask in the MODs channel about you, and if nobody knows you .. it's hard to make a case for adding you in. I also ask other moderators to suggest candidates for moderators when we need more coverage. I can recommend you becoming a supporter, which also gets you access to great discussions related to game features.

Please do not beg/bother/annoy current moderators to be nominated to be a moderator. The moderators will certainly vote “no” if you are nominated.

At the moment, we have good coverage in terms of moderating our English rooms. We do not need more moderators, even though senior players are reaching out. We may still be looking for moderators to help out with the growing communities of new languages that we added.

I hope this has given a nice insight, feel free to contact one of the moderators at any time.

zh-cn.title: 协管指南
zh-cn.body:
协管

协管的主要工作是监控聊天室，寻找我们可以参与的有意义的讨论，并帮助有疑问、建议或担忧的玩家。作为协管，最重要的工作是确保我们的玩家不仅遵守我们的条款与条件，而且尽可能享受美好时光！

当协管调出玩家的个人资料时，他们会在公司名称下看到以下内容：

封禁能力

协管可以决定是否向玩家发出警告，或者在极端情况下立即应用聊天禁令。

聊天禁令是临时禁令，禁止玩家使用聊天室。

在大多数情况下，我们可以在封禁玩家之前找到解决方案。许多“违规”只是玩家在测试界限，如果被提醒，他们会停止。

为了实现公平和合作的封禁，系统会根据之前的违规次数自动确定封禁时间。屡犯者的封禁时间越来越长：

渐进式系统从 2 小时开始；并遵循以下模式：2、2、8、16、32、64 等等。

系统还会根据对同一 IP 上的玩家的多次封禁自动确定何时封禁整个 IP 并拒绝新注册。目标是阻止违规者立即创建第二个帐户以规避封禁。

对于未公开的棘手案例，我们还有一些技巧。当我们不再认为玩家的攻击行为可以改变，并试图阻止他/她使用聊天时，就会应用这些。

公司身份违反 T&C

如果选择警告，用户将收到一条 PA 消息，要求违规者更新其个人资料信息。个人助理也会在一段时间后提醒 MOD 聊天室，以便 MOD 可以检查用户是否遵守。同样，系统会根据违规历史确定何时发出警告和何时禁止。低级别违规公司可以立即被删除。

协管聊天室

协管可以访问协管聊天室和支持者聊天室。

在协管聊天室中，我们讨论违规者、应实施的禁令以及玩家是否已收到警告。我们还讨论徽标或公司描述是否超出了条款和条件的范围。紧迫的技术问题也得到了提出。协管还可以访问支持者聊天室（这是 Patrik 给予他们的礼遇）。支持者聊天室讨论了新想法、即将开展的项目以及 Patrik 向我们询问的许多事情的意见。
协管能够查看其他玩家的哈希 IP 地址。这是一个方便的工具，尤其是在与使用我们游戏的学校打交道时。他们不会与任何人分享这些信息！玩家隐私对我们非常重要！

协管是被任命的

协管没有申请程序。协管是在被提名为候选人并在 Mod 聊天中讨论后选出的。

以下列表不是一份核对清单，并不是通过后您便成为协管。有许多对社区有帮助的经验丰富的玩家并没有担任协管。当我们考虑扩大协管团队时，我们会在 MODs 频道讨论可能的候选人。我们试图找到符合以下条件的候选人：

  • 是活跃的玩家并且了解游戏 - 当在帮助聊天室发布有用的回复时，这一点很容易看出

  • 与现有协管关系良好

  • 经审核，没有先前拥有多个帐户的作弊记录 - 我们比 公平竞争协会 更严格

  • 头脑冷静，脸皮还要和我一样厚 ;)

  • 为 Sim Companies times 贡献了一篇好文章

  • 我们倾向于选择经验丰富的玩家

  • 会说多种语言是一大优势

注意：直接写信给我，Patrik，没有帮助。在很多情况下，我只是在 MODs 频道询问你的情况，如果没有人认识你……就很难提出将你加入的理由。当我们需要更多协管时，我也会请其他协管推荐候选人。我可以推荐你成为支持者，这也让你能够参与与游戏功能相关的精彩讨论。

请不要乞求/打扰/惹恼现任协管提名你成为协管。如果你被提名，协管肯定会投“反对”票。

目前，我们在管理英语房间方面有很好的覆盖面。我们不需要更多的（英语）协管，尽管资深玩家正在联系。我们可能仍在寻找协管来帮助我们增加新语言社区。

我希望这能给你一个很好的见解，欢迎随时联系其中一位 协管。

en.title: Submission to Sim Companies Times guidelines
en.body:
Maintained by The Center

The Sim Companies Times has provided us with a lot of insight into different markets, how contracts compare to selling retail, and many have contributed their advice in player-written articles. It is that last category that really makes it special.

We'd like you to write for the Times!

Rules for submitting draft articles for the Sim Companies Times:

  1. Post the article to a shareable site such as google documents.

  2. Use this form to submit an article.

  3. The editors will notify you if your work is accepted, needs further editing, or is rejected.

Guidelines:

  • Length should be a standard essay length - Introduction, 3 paragraph body, and summary. This is not a strict requirement, but overly long articles will be rejected. Word limit: for English is 1200 words (this allows for translations into other languages).

  • The article should be related to the game in some way - both general advice and specific personal insights are welcome.

  • The article should not be written with the intent of discrediting another or as an advertisement for your company.

  • Submissions can be made at any time.

  • You will be notified the week your submission will be published in the Times. 

  • We will NOT accept game suggestions. If you would like to make Suggestions please visit our Forum to do so.

  • We will NOT accepts AI generated articles.

  • Acceptance will be judged by moderators based on criteria including but not limited to:

Creativity, Conciseness, Conveyance of Game or Basic Economic Principles, Relevance, and Wit.

Please note: that submissions take time to review and be published in the Sim Times.  Do not expect to submit and be published in the same week.  The queue at times can be as long as 8 weeks to be published.

Disclaimer: All articles that are player-written-articles are the opinion (editorial) of that author and do not reflect the opinions and beliefs of the Sim Companies or its affiliates (developers, moderators, editors).

If you have any questions you can contact the editor(s) of the Sim Companies Times:
KingPeer Companies 

Unexpected

SM Technologies Inc

 We look forward to your contributions!

When linking a Google Document when submitting, use the Share button at the top.
Then make sure to edit the link from Viewer to either: Commenter or Editor
This allows us to make suggestions on your article.

Meme Submissions

When submitting a meme for the Sim Times, please make sure the meme is appropriate for the game and is game related in some way.

For some examples of memes that were Published see:
Sim Companies Times 167

Sim Companies Times 151

Submitting can be done by sending a link of any image sharing site: Snipboard, Imgur, Imgbb, Google, etc.

zh-cn.title: 提交《Sim Companies时报》文章规则
zh-cn.body:
由The Center维护 / 由Silverman AG翻译

《Sim Companies时报》为我们提供了很多关于不同市场的见解，合同与零售业的比较，而且许多人在玩家写的文章中贡献了他们的想法。正是这最后一类，使它真正变得特别。

我们希望你能为《Sim Companies时报》撰稿!

提交草稿规则：

  1. 发布你的草稿到一个合作平台上，例如谷歌文档等

  2. 使用该链接提交文章

  3. 报纸编辑们会告诉你，你的草稿是否被接受，需要编辑，或被拒绝。

准则：

  • 文章应该是标准的论文长度-- 导言、3段正文和总结。这不是一个严格的要求，但过长的文章会被拒绝。字数限制（英文）：1200字（这允许翻译成其他语言）。

  • 文章应在某种程度上与游戏有关-- 一般建议和具体的个人见解都可以。

  • 写文章的目的不应该是为了诋毁别人，也不应该是为你的公司做广告。

  • 你可以随时提交草稿。

  • 在你的投稿发表之前，你将得到通知。

  • 接受与否将由协管根据包括，但不限于以下标准进行判断：

创造性、简洁性、与游戏或经济原则的关系、关联性和智慧。

请注意：提交的草稿文章需要时间来审查。不要指望在同一周内提交草稿和发表文章。排队时间有时可长达8周。

我们期待着你的贡献！

声明：所有由玩家撰写的文章均为该作者的观点（社论），并不反映 Sim 公司或其附属公司（开发者、版主、编辑）的观点和信念。

如果你提交了一个谷歌文档，请点击顶部的“分享”按钮。然后确保将设置从“查看者”改为：“评论者”或“编辑者”。这使我们能够对你的文章提出建议。

模因提交

向《Sim 时报》提交模因时，请确保该模因适合游戏并且在某种程度上与游戏相关。

有关已发布的模因的一些示例，请参阅：
Sim Companies 时报 167

Sim Companies 时报 151

可以通过发送任何图像共享网站的链接来完成提交：Snipboard、Imgur、Imgbb、Google 等。

en.title: Fair Play Association
en.body:
Fair Play Association (FPA)

The Fair Play Association's primary objective is to guarantee equitable market conditions for all companies.

Core Principles:

  • Multi-Account Prohibition: Controlling more than one account gives unfair market advantage and is strictly forbidden.
  • Transfer Pricing Enforcement: Selling resources at artificial discounts or premiums to affiliated companies triggers audit review.
  • Fair Market Access: Every player has equal access to the exchange and public contracts.

zh-cn.title: 公平竞争协会 (FPA)
zh-cn.body:
公平竞争协会 (FPA)

公平竞争协会（FPA）的核心目标是为所有玩家企业保障公平、公正的市场竞争环境。

核心规则守则：

  • 严禁多账号操作: 一位玩家严禁控制多个企业账号。多开账号转移利益属于严重违规行为。
  • 非正常转移定价限制: 严禁通过极端偏离市场参考价格（如 $0.01）的方式进行利益输送。
  • 平等的交易权利: 保障每一位企业主在自由市场与合同大厅中享受平等的定价与交易权利。

en.title: Fair Play Association
en.body:
Fair Play Association (FPA)

The Fair Play Association's primary objective is to guarantee equitable market conditions for all companies.

Core Principles:

  • Multi-Account Prohibition: Controlling more than one account gives unfair market advantage and is strictly forbidden.
  • Transfer Pricing Enforcement: Selling resources at artificial discounts or premiums to affiliated companies triggers audit review.
  • Fair Market Access: Every player has equal access to the exchange and public contracts.
